name: Listril 10mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About LISTRIL 10MG TABLET

LISTRIL 10MG TABLET contains Lisinopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty in breathing, swollen ankles and feet or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity) and can reduce kidney damage in diabetic patients who have high blood pressure.

Before taking LISTRIL 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

LISTRIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking LISTRIL 10MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with LISTRIL 10MG TABLET.

LISTRIL 10MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate your dizziness.

Other most common side effects of taking LISTRIL 10MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, nausea and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How LISTRIL 10MG TABLET Works

LISTRIL 10MG TABLET is an ACE inhibitor. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE), that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart and the kidneys. This reduces strain on the heart and kidneys, improves their functions and manages the risks of heart failure or kidney damage.
usageDetails:
How to use LISTRIL 10MG TABLET

Take LISTRIL 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. LISTRIL 10MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking LISTRIL 10MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

warnings.details: LISTRIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing fetus. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking LISTRIL 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. If you accidentally become pregnant while undergoing therapy with LISTRIL 10MG TABLET, stop taking this medicine and inform your doctor immediately.
LISTRIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
LISTRIL 10MG TABLET may make you feel tired or dizzy. Therefore, do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines as a precaution.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking LISTRIL 10MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure and make you feel dizzier or faint

LISTRIL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (including narrowing or blood vessels supplying the kidneys, dialysis or kidney transplantation). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
LISTRIL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take LISTRIL 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to Lisinopril or to any other ACE inhibitors (such as captopril, enalapril, ramipril).

LISTRIL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems apart from hypertension and heart failure (such as irregular heartbeat, heart valve disease or enlarged heart). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

LISTRIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have diabetes with impaired kidney functions

Before taking LISTRIL 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have hypotension (low blood pressure)
Have stroke or mini stroke
Are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness such as vomiting or diarrhea
Have diabetes
Have any autoimmune disease that affects the skin or collagen (Ex. lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis, or scleroderma)
Are scheduled for any upcoming surgery (including minor dental surgery)
Are scheduled for LDL apheresis (a procedure used to remove cholesterol from the blood)
Have any desensitization management (used to reduce the effect of an allergy to bee or wasp stings)
Have high levels of potassium in the blood

Use in paediatrics:

LISTRIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) unless prescribed by a physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before consumption.

Use in geriatrics:

LISTRIL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking LISTRIL 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Racecadotril (a medicine used to manage diarrhea)
Medicines that supplement potassium to the body (Ex. spironolactone, triamterene or amiloride)
Trimethoprim containing antibiotics (used for infections)
Medicines used to manage organ transplant rejection (Ex. ciclosporin, temsirolimus, sirolimus, everolimus)
Heparin (used to manage blood clots)
Medicines used for heart conditions such as hypertension, chest pain, irregular heartbeats or heart failure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, furosemide, bumetanide, nitroglycerin, valsartan, aliskiren, procainamide, sacubitril/valsartan)
Lithium (a medicine used in some types of mental illness)
Tricyclic antidepressants (used to manage depression) Ex. amitriptyline
Antipsychotics (used to manage serious mental illnesses) Ex. clozapine, risperidone
Anesthetics (used to manage pain during surgery) Ex. propofol, thiopental, lidocaine
Medicines used to relieve pain (Ex. morphine, aspirin, ibuprofen, celecoxib, valdecoxib)
Gold therapy (used to manage rheumatic conditions)
Medicines used to suppress cough (such as dextromethorphan, guaiphenesin, pseudoephedrine)
Anti-diabetic medicines and insulin (used to lower the blood glucose level) Ex. vildagliptin, metformin, gliclazide
Allopurinol (a medicine used to reduce blood uric acid levels)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more LISTRIL 10MG TABLET, contact your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include severe dizziness or light-headedness with fainting, fast heartbeat, anxiety, cough and fast breathing.

introduction:
Introduction About CARDACE 2.5MG TABLET

CARDACE 2.5MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of compounds known as Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors. This medication is generally prescribed under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner for cardiovascular health support and blood pressure management.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with the medicine.

CARDACE 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding women, consult your doctor for advice before taking CARDACE 2.5MG TABLET. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects of taking CARDACE 2.5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea or skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How CARDACE 2.5MG TABLET Works
1. Role of ACE Inhibition in CARDACE 2.5MG TABLET

CARDACE 2.5MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. These medicines work by gently blocking the enzyme called Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme (ACE). This enzyme plays a part in narrowing blood vessels. By inhibiting ACE, CARDACE 2.5MG TABLET helps blood vessels stay relaxed and open, allowing blood to flow more freely. This supports the body’s natural process of maintaining balanced blood pressure levels.

2. How CARDACE 2.5MG TABLET affects blood flow and vessel function

By helping blood vessels relax, CARDACE 2.5MG TABLET improves blood flow throughout the body. This eases of blood flow reduces the effort the heart needs to pump blood, which supports overall cardiovascular health. When blood vessels work efficiently, organs and tissues receive the oxygen and nutrients they need to function well.

3. Ramipril and its interaction with the cardiovascular system

Ramipril influences the cardiovascular system by targeting the renin-angiotensin system, which regulates blood vessel constriction and fluid balance. By balancing this system, ramipril encourages healthier vessel function and supports the regulation of fluid levels in the body, which can influence blood pressure and heart workload.

4. How CARDACE 2.5MG TABLET supports natural blood pressure regulation

CARDACE 2.5MG TABLET assists the body’s natural mechanisms to regulate blood pressure without abrupt changes. This gradual support helps to maintain steady blood pressure, which is important for reducing stress on the heart and blood vessels over time. Using CARDACE 2.5MG TABLET as directed under medical supervision helps promote this balanced approach to cardiovascular health.

CARDACE 2.5MG TABLET(Ramipril) is often used for ongoing support under the supervision of a healthcare professional. CARDACE 10MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension). Blood pressure is the force exerted by the circulating blood on the walls of blood vessels. Hypertension is a condition in which the blood pressure is too high.

CARDACE 10MG TABLET is also used to manage heart failure (a condition when the heart is not able to pump enough blood). Symptoms include headache, breathlessness, excess sweating, sleep disturbance, tingling and dizziness.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with CARDACE 10MG TABLET.

CARDACE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking CARDACE 10MG TABLET. CARDACE 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). CARDACE 10MG TABLET decreases blood pressure by decreasing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). CARDACE 10MG TABLET distributes extensively amongst your body tissues. As a result, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

Before taking CARDACE 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Non-Steroidal AntiInflammatory Drugs (used to relieve pain and inflammation) Ex. ibuprofen or indomethacin and aspirin

Heparin (used for thinning blood)
Prednisolone (steroid used to reduce inflammation)
Allopurinol (used to lower uric acid in blood)
Procainamide (used for heart rhythm problems)
Racecadotril (used to manage diarrhea)
Immunosuppressants (used to suppress the immune system) ex. temsirolimus, everolimus, sirolimus

introduction:
Introduction About RAMISTAR 5MG TABLET

RAMISTAR 5MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the category of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. This tablet is often considered by healthcare professionals for maintaining heart and vascular health like hypertension and heart failure. It is a prescription-only medication and must be used under medical supervision.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Also might advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with RAMISTAR 5MG TABLET.

RAMISTAR 5MG TABLET is not advisable for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, inform your doctor for advice before taking RAMISTAR 5MG TABLET. It is not considered for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

Recommended Timing and Frequency of RAMISTAR 5MG TABLET

RAMISTAR 5MG TABLET is typically taken once daily, preferably at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in the bloodstream.

Some patients may be advised to take it in the morning, while others may benefit from an evening dose depending on their condition and treatment plan. It is important to follow your doctor’s instructions carefully and not alter the timing or frequency without consulting them.

Who Decides the Right Dosage for You?

The dosage of RAMISTAR 5MG TABLET is determined by your healthcare provider based on your medical history, current health status, and response to therapy. It’s important to have an open discussion with your doctor before starting or adjusting your medication.

Should RAMISTAR 5MG TABLET Be Taken With Food?

RAMISTAR 5MG TABLET can generally be taken with or without food. Taking it with meals may help reduce occasional stomach discomfort. It’s best to maintain a consistent routine by taking the tablet at the same time each day to support steady blood levels of the medicine.

General Administration Instructions
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water.
Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to ensure proper absorption.
Follow the exact dosage and schedule prescribed by your healthcare provider.
Things to Remember While Using RAMISTAR 5MG TABLET
Do not skip doses to maintain effectiveness.
Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking.
Regular check-ups may be advised to monitor your health and kidney function.
Avoid sudden changes in posture to prevent dizziness.
Importance of Following Your Doctor’s Schedule

Adhering to the prescribed schedule helps in maintaining stable blood pressure and reduces strain on the heart. Any changes in dosage or frequency should be made only under medical supervision.

More Information
What to Discuss With Your Doctor Before Using RAMISTAR 5MG TABLET

Before starting RAMISTAR 5MG TABLET, it’s important to have an open conversation with your healthcare provider to ensure safe and effective use. Consider discussing the following points:

Your Medical History: Inform your doctor about any history of kidney or liver problems, heart conditions, or allergies.
Current Medications: Share details of all prescription, over-the-counter medicines, supplements, and herbal products you are taking.
Pregnancy or Breastfeeding: If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, discuss the potential risks and alternatives.
Symptoms to Watch For: Understand which symptoms or side effects require immediate medical attention, such as swelling, severe dizziness, or difficulty breathing.
Lifestyle Factors: Talk about your diet, alcohol use, and any lifestyle habits that may affect your medication’s effectiveness.
Follow-up Plan: Clarify how often you should have check-ups or blood tests to monitor your progress and safety.
Medicines Often Prescribed Alongside ACE Inhibitors

RAMISTAR 5MG TABLET belongs to the class of ACE inhibitors commonly used in managing cardiovascular health. Doctors may prescribe additional medicines to complement its effects, such as:

Diuretics (Water Pills): Help reduce excess fluid and support blood pressure control.
Beta-Blockers: Assist in managing heart rate and reducing heart strain.
Calcium Channel Blockers: Help relax blood vessels and improve blood flow.
Statins: Used to manage cholesterol levels as part of overall heart health.
Tablets Used in Cardiac Management Plans

Beyond ACE inhibitors like RAMISTAR 5MG TABLET, cardiac care often involves a variety of tablets tailored to support heart function and circulation, including:

Antiplatelet agents to reduce blood clot risks
Nitrates to ease chest discomfort
Blood thinners for certain heart conditions
Medicines to manage cholesterol and lipid levels

CARDACE 1.25MG TABLET reduces the risk of kidney problems and can be used as a management following a heart attack. CARDACE 1.25MG TABLET is also used to manage heart failure (a condition when the heart is not able to pump enough blood). Symptoms include headache, breathlessness, excess sweating, sleep disturbance, tingling and dizziness.

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking CARDACE 1.25MG TABLET. CARDACE 1.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

Introduction About RAMISTAR 2.5MG TABLET

RAMISTAR 2.5MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of compounds known as Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors. This medication is generally prescribed under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner for cardiovascular health support and blood pressure management.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with the medicine.

RAMISTAR 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding women, consult your doctor for advice before taking RAMISTAR 2.5MG TABLET. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects of taking RAMISTAR 2.5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea or skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMISTAR 2.5MG TABLET Works
1. Role of ACE Inhibition in RAMISTAR 2.5MG TABLET

RAMISTAR 2.5MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. These medicines work by gently blocking the enzyme called Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme (ACE). This enzyme plays a part in narrowing blood vessels. By inhibiting ACE, RAMISTAR 2.5MG TABLET helps blood vessels stay relaxed and open, allowing blood to flow more freely. This supports the body’s natural process of maintaining balanced blood pressure levels.

2. How RAMISTAR 2.5MG TABLET affects blood flow and vessel function

By helping blood vessels relax, RAMISTAR 2.5MG TABLET improves blood flow throughout the body. This eases of blood flow reduces the effort the heart needs to pump blood, which supports overall cardiovascular health. When blood vessels work efficiently, organs and tissues receive the oxygen and nutrients they need to function well.

3. Ramipril and its interaction with the cardiovascular system

Ramipril influences the cardiovascular system by targeting the renin-angiotensin system, which regulates blood vessel constriction and fluid balance. By balancing this system, ramipril encourages healthier vessel function and supports the regulation of fluid levels in the body, which can influence blood pressure and heart workload.

4. How RAMISTAR 2.5MG TABLET supports natural blood pressure regulation

RAMISTAR 2.5MG TABLET assists the body’s natural mechanisms to regulate blood pressure without abrupt changes. This gradual support helps to maintain steady blood pressure, which is important for reducing stress on the heart and blood vessels over time. Using RAMISTAR 2.5MG TABLET as directed under medical supervision helps promote this balanced approach to cardiovascular health.

Introduction About RAMISTAR 10MG TABLET

RAMISTAR 10MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension). Blood pressure is the force exerted by the circulating blood on the walls of blood vessels. Hypertension is a condition in which the blood pressure is too high.

RAMISTAR 10MG TABLET reduces the risk of kidney problems and can be used as a management following a heart attack. RAMISTAR 10MG TABLET is also used to manage heart failure (a condition when the heart is not able to pump enough blood). Symptoms include headache, breathlessness, excess sweating, sleep disturbance, tingling and dizziness.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with RAMISTAR 10MG TABLET.

RAMISTAR 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking RAMISTAR 10MG TABLET. RAMISTAR 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

Confusion and fits

introduction:
Introduction About CARDACE H 5 TABLET

CARDACE H 5 TABLET is a combination of Ramipril and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors and Diuretics respectively. It is used in the management of essential hypertension.

Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke.

Before taking CARDACE H 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. Inform your doctor if you have any problems related to kidney, liver, lungs or heart and if you have other conditions such as diabetes, gout, myopia, glaucoma, collagen vascular disease or parathyroid disease.

CARDACE H 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents less than 18 years of age. If you are taking any other medicines for other conditions or if you have history of allergy, inform to your doctor as it may manage drug-related interactions and serious side effect.

The most common side effect of CARDACE H 5 TABLET are headache, dizziness, stomach pain, tiredness and nausea. Consult your doctor for advice if your symptoms get worsen over the time.
uses: Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CARDACE H 5 TABLET
Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How CARDACE H 5 TABLET Works

CARDACE H 5 TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where Ramipril works by inhibiting the activity of an enzyme called Angiotensin converting enzyme (an enzyme which is responsible for causing constriction of blood vessels) which enhances easy flow of blood around the body. Hydrochlorothiazide works by decreasing the extra fluid volume also works by managing reabsorption of sodium in the kidneys, which in turn it relaxes the blood vessels and makes the blood flow more easily in the passage of blood vessels and thus lowers the blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use CARDACE H 5 TABLET

Always take CARDACE H 5 TABLET as directed by your physician. Take this medicine with or without food, swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

Difficulty urination
Personal or family history of angioedema
Electrolyte disturbances

Diabetes
Scleroderma or systemic lupus erythematosus
Dehydration problems
Upcoming major surgery including dental surgery which requires anaesthesia for numbness or sedation
Personal or family history of skin cancer
High levels of potassium in the blood
Acute myopia and secondary angle-closure glaucoma
Parathyroid disease
Gout or increased levels of uric acid in the blood
Raynaud’s phenomenon (condition resulting from poor circulation in the extremities, such as fingers and toes)

CARDACE H 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents less than 18 years of age. Consult with your doctor for advice before taking CARDACE H 5 TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About ENVAS 5MG TABLET

ENVAS 5MG TABLET contains Enalapril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty breathing, swollen ankles and feet, or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity).

Before taking ENVAS 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you are on a low-salt diet, have diabetes, or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

ENVAS 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure) and in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking ENVAS 5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with ENVAS 5MG TABLET.

ENVAS 5MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol, as it could aggravate your dizziness.

ENVAS 5MG TABLET may reduce your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels during the therapy to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Other most common side effects of taking ENVAS 5MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, tiredness, and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ENVAS 5MG TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How ENVAS 5MG TABLET Works

ENVAS 5MG TABLET effectively reduces blood pressure and signs of heart failure. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles, which reduces strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart failure.
usageDetails:
How to use ENVAS 5MG TABLET

Take ENVAS 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. ENVAS 5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking ENVAS 5MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About COVERSYL 8MG TABLET

COVERSYL 8MG TABLET contains Perindopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension in adults. Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against blood vessel walls is too high. Symptoms of hypertension includes early morning headaches, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, feeling overtiredness, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, and chest pain. It is also used to manage heart failure (a condition where the pumping of heart is inadequate to meet body’s need which is characterized by shortness of breath, fatigue, fast heartbeat.). It also reduces the risk of cardiac events such as heart attack in patients with stable coronary artery disease (a condition where the blood supply to the heart is reduced or blocked resulting in pain or discomfort in chest, arms or shoulders; weakness, light-headedness and feeling sick), in patients who have the history of heart attack and/or an operation to improve blood supply to heart.

Perindopril works by inhibiting the activity of an enzyme called angiotensin converting enzyme (an enzyme which is responsible for causing constriction of blood vessels), resulting in easy flow of blood around the body. Your doctor may check your kidney function, blood pressure, and the amount of electrolytes (Ex. potassium) in your body prior to the management or at regular intervals along with the management.

COVERSYL 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney artery stenosis.  COVERSYL 8MG TABLET should be used in caution with patient having aortic stenosis, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, diabetes, liver, and kidney problems or under dialysis. If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. COVERSYL 8MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years. The most common side effects of taking COVERSYL 8MG TABLET are low blood pressure, headache, dizziness, muscle cramps, shortness of breath, cough and headache. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

Introduction About RAMICON 2.5 TABLET

RAMICON 2.5 TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of compounds known as Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors. This medication is generally prescribed under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner for cardiovascular health support and blood pressure management.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with the medicine.

RAMICON 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding women, consult your doctor for advice before taking RAMICON 2.5 TABLET. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects of taking RAMICON 2.5 TABLET are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea or skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMICON 2.5 TABLET Works
1. Role of ACE Inhibition in RAMICON 2.5 TABLET

RAMICON 2.5 TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. These medicines work by gently blocking the enzyme called Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme (ACE). This enzyme plays a part in narrowing blood vessels. By inhibiting ACE, RAMICON 2.5 TABLET helps blood vessels stay relaxed and open, allowing blood to flow more freely. This supports the body’s natural process of maintaining balanced blood pressure levels.

2. How RAMICON 2.5 TABLET affects blood flow and vessel function

By helping blood vessels relax, RAMICON 2.5 TABLET improves blood flow throughout the body. This eases of blood flow reduces the effort the heart needs to pump blood, which supports overall cardiovascular health. When blood vessels work efficiently, organs and tissues receive the oxygen and nutrients they need to function well.

3. Ramipril and its interaction with the cardiovascular system

Ramipril influences the cardiovascular system by targeting the renin-angiotensin system, which regulates blood vessel constriction and fluid balance. By balancing this system, ramipril encourages healthier vessel function and supports the regulation of fluid levels in the body, which can influence blood pressure and heart workload.

4. How RAMICON 2.5 TABLET supports natural blood pressure regulation

RAMICON 2.5 TABLET assists the body’s natural mechanisms to regulate blood pressure without abrupt changes. This gradual support helps to maintain steady blood pressure, which is important for reducing stress on the heart and blood vessels over time. Using RAMICON 2.5 TABLET as directed under medical supervision helps promote this balanced approach to cardiovascular health.

name: Amace Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMACE TABLET

AMACE TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Enalapril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and certain type of angina (chest pain) called as Prinzmetal or variant angina. It can also be used to manage heart failure and reduce the chances of hospitalization among the heart patients.

Before taking AMACE TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension, angina and heart failure (such as cardiogenic shock or narrowing of heart valves).

Talk to your doctor if you are on a low salt diet or have diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea) before taking AMACE TABLET as a precaution.

AMACE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure). It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects.

The most common side effects of taking AMACE TABLET are dizziness, swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, low blood sugar levels and muscle cramps. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:

Manage hypertension
Manage angina (such as Prinzmetal Angina)

mechanismOfAction:
How AMACE TABLET Works

AMACE TABLET is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs. This improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces strain on the heart. It also allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. As a result, it reduces blood pressure and improves heart functions.
usageDetails:
How to use AMACE TABLET

Take AMACE TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. AMACE TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Continue to take AMACE TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Therefore, inform your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. If you accidentally become pregnant while undergoing therapy with AMACE TABLET, inform your doctor immediately.
AMACE TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking AMACE TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking AMACE TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure and make you feel dizzier or faint.

AMACE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment (including dialysis). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems (including kidney transplantation). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
AMACE TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take AMACE TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine, Enalapril or to any other calcium antagonists (such as nifedipine, diltiazem) or ACE inhibitors (such as captopril, lisinopril, ramipril).

AMACE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

AMACE TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have diabetes with impaired kidney functions

Before taking AMACE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have problems in the blood vessels supplying the brain
Are on a salt-restricted diet
Are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness such as vomiting or diarrhea
Have low WBC, RBC and platelet count in the blood
Have diabetes
Have any autoimmune disease that affects the skin or collagen (Ex. lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis or scleroderma)
Are scheduled for any upcoming surgery
Are scheduled for LDL apheresis (a procedure to remove cholesterol from the blood)
Have any desensitization management (used to reduce the effect of an allergy to bee or wasp stings)

Use in Paediatrics:

AMACE TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) unless prescribed by a physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before consumption.

Use in Geriatrics:

AMACE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking AMACE TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Racecadotril (a medicine used to manage diarrhea)
Medicines that supplement potassium to the body (Ex. spironolactone, triamterene or amiloride)
Trimethoprim containing antibiotics (used for infections)
Medicines used to manage organ transplant rejection (Ex. ciclosporin, temsirolimus, sirolimus, everolimus)
Heparin (used to manage blood clots)
Medicines used for heart conditions such as hypertension, chest pain, irregular heartbeats or heart failure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, furosemide, bumetanide, nitroglycerin, valsartan, aliskiren, procainamide, sacubitril/valsartan)
Lithium (a medicine used in some types of mental illness)
Tricyclic antidepressants (used to manage depression) Ex. amitriptyline
Antipsychotics (used to manage serious mental illnesses) Ex. clozapine, risperidone
Anesthetics (used to manage pain during surgery) Ex. propofol, thiopental
Medicines used to relieve pain (Ex. morphine, aspirin, ibuprofen, celecoxib, valdecoxib)
Thrombolytics (used to dissolve blood clots) Ex. reteplase, tenecteplase
Gold therapy (used to manage rheumatic conditions)
Medicines used to suppress cough (such as dextromethorphan, guaiphenesin, pseudoephedrine)
Anti-diabetic medicines and insulin (used to lower the blood glucose level) Ex. vildagliptin, metformin

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMACE TABLET, as it could reduce your blood pressure to an abnormal level.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more AMACE TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include dizziness, fainting, light-headedness, weakness, shock, cool or clampy skin fast heartbeat, anxiety, cough and shortness of breath.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking AMLOVAS L TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Racecadotril (a medicine used to manage diarrhea)
Medicines that supplement potassium to the body (Ex. spironolactone, triamterene or amiloride)
Trimethoprim containing antibiotics (used for infections)
Medicines used to manage organ transplant rejection (Ex. ciclosporin, temsirolimus, sirolimus, everolimus)
Heparin (used to manage blood clots)
Medicines used for heart conditions such as hypertension, chest pain, irregular heartbeats or heart failure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, furosemide, bumetanide, nitroglycerin, valsartan, aliskiren, procainamide, sacubitril/valsartan)
Lithium (a medicine used in some types of mental illness)
Tricyclic antidepressants (used to manage depression) Ex. amitriptyline
Antipsychotics (used to manage serious mental illnesses) Ex. clozapine, risperidone
Anesthetics (used to manage pain during surgery) Ex. propofol, thiopental, proparacaine, lignocaine
Medicines used to relieve pain (Ex. morphine, aspirin, ibuprofen, celecoxib, valdecoxib)
Thrombolytics (used to dissolve blood clots) Ex. reteplase, tenecteplase
Gold therapy (used to manage rheumatic conditions)
Medicines used to suppress cough (such as dextromethorphan, guaiphenesin, pseudoephedrine)
Anti-diabetic medicines and insulin (used to lower the blood glucose level) Ex. vildagliptin, metformin
Other medicines used to manage high blood pressure or angina (Ex. diltiazem, verapamil)
Ketoconazole, itraconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Ritonavir, indinavir, nelfinavir (used in management of HIV infections)
Rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Dantrolene (a medicine used to manage muscle spasms)
Medicines used to control elevated cholesterol levels (Ex. simvastatin)
St. John’s wort (an herbal medicine used to manage depression)

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMLOVAS L TABLET, as it could reduce your blood pressure to an abnormal level.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more AMLOVAS L TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include dizziness, fainting, light-headedness, weakness, shock, cool or clampy skin, fast heartbeat, anxiety, cough and shortness of breath.

Introduction About RAMIPRES 2.5MG TABLET

RAMIPRES 2.5MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of compounds known as Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors. This medication is generally prescribed under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner for cardiovascular health support and blood pressure management.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with the medicine.

RAMIPRES 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding women, consult your doctor for advice before taking RAMIPRES 2.5MG TABLET. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects of taking RAMIPRES 2.5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea or skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMIPRES 2.5MG TABLET Works
1. Role of ACE Inhibition in RAMIPRES 2.5MG TABLET

RAMIPRES 2.5MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. These medicines work by gently blocking the enzyme called Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme (ACE). This enzyme plays a part in narrowing blood vessels. By inhibiting ACE, RAMIPRES 2.5MG TABLET helps blood vessels stay relaxed and open, allowing blood to flow more freely. This supports the body’s natural process of maintaining balanced blood pressure levels.

2. How RAMIPRES 2.5MG TABLET affects blood flow and vessel function

By helping blood vessels relax, RAMIPRES 2.5MG TABLET improves blood flow throughout the body. This eases of blood flow reduces the effort the heart needs to pump blood, which supports overall cardiovascular health. When blood vessels work efficiently, organs and tissues receive the oxygen and nutrients they need to function well.

3. Ramipril and its interaction with the cardiovascular system

Ramipril influences the cardiovascular system by targeting the renin-angiotensin system, which regulates blood vessel constriction and fluid balance. By balancing this system, ramipril encourages healthier vessel function and supports the regulation of fluid levels in the body, which can influence blood pressure and heart workload.

4. How RAMIPRES 2.5MG TABLET supports natural blood pressure regulation

RAMIPRES 2.5MG TABLET assists the body’s natural mechanisms to regulate blood pressure without abrupt changes. This gradual support helps to maintain steady blood pressure, which is important for reducing stress on the heart and blood vessels over time. Using RAMIPRES 2.5MG TABLET as directed under medical supervision helps promote this balanced approach to cardiovascular health.

name: Lipril 5mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About LIPRIL 5MG TABLET

LIPRIL 5MG TABLET contains Lisinopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty in breathing, swollen ankles and feet or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity) and can reduce kidney damage in diabetic patients who have high blood pressure.

Before taking LIPRIL 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

LIPRIL 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking LIPRIL 5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with LIPRIL 5MG TABLET.

LIPRIL 5MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate your dizziness.

Other most common side effects of taking LIPRIL 5MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, nausea and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart and the kidneys. This reduces strain on the heart and kidneys, improves their functions and manages the risks of heart failure or kidney damage.

introduction:
Introduction About CARDACE H 2.5 TABLET

CARDACE H 2.5 TABLET is a combination of Ramipril and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors and Diuretics respectively. It is used in the management of essential hypertension.

Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke.

Before taking CARDACE H 2.5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. Inform your doctor if you have any problems related to kidney, liver, lungs or heart and if you have other conditions such as diabetes, gout, myopia, glaucoma, collagen vascular disease or parathyroid disease.

CARDACE H 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents less than 18 years of age. If you are taking any other medicines for other conditions or if you have history of allergy, inform to your doctor as it may manage drug-related interactions and serious side effect.

The most common side effect of CARDACE H 2.5 TABLET are headache, dizziness, stomach pain, tiredness and nausea. Consult your doctor for advice if your symptoms get worsen over the time.
uses: Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CARDACE H 2.5 TABLET
Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How CARDACE H 2.5 TABLET Works

CARDACE H 2.5 TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where Ramipril works by inhibiting the activity of an enzyme called Angiotensin converting enzyme (an enzyme which is responsible for causing constriction of blood vessels) which enhances easy flow of blood around the body. Hydrochlorothiazide works by decreasing the extra fluid volume also works by managing reabsorption of sodium in the kidneys, which in turn it relaxes the blood vessels and makes the blood flow more easily in the passage of blood vessels and thus lowers the blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use CARDACE H 2.5 TABLET

Always take CARDACE H 2.5 TABLET as directed by your physician. Take this medicine with or without food, swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition.

Personal or family history of angioedema

Upcoming major surgery including dental surgery which requires anaesthesia for numbness or sedation
Personal or family history of skin cancer
High levels of potassium in the blood

introduction:
Introduction About RAMIPRES 5MG TABLET

RAMIPRES 5MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the category of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. This tablet is often considered by healthcare professionals for maintaining heart and vascular health like hypertension and heart failure. It is a prescription-only medication and must be used under medical supervision.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Also might advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with RAMIPRES 5MG TABLET.

RAMIPRES 5MG TABLET is not advisable for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, inform your doctor for advice before taking RAMIPRES 5MG TABLET. It is not considered for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.
uses: Risk of getting a heart attack or stroke and slow down the worsening of kidney problems
usesDetails:
Uses Of RAMIPRES 5MG TABLET

Manages

Increased blood pressure, heart failure
Risk of getting a heart attack or stroke and slow down the worsening of kidney problems
mechanismOfAction:
How RAMIPRES 5MG TABLET Works

RAMIPRES 5MG TABLET decreases blood pressure by reducing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). RAMIPRES 5MG TABLET distributes well amongst your body tissues. Which in turn, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.
usageInstructions: Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water.
Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to ensure proper absorption.
Follow the exact dosage and schedule prescribed by your healthcare provider.
Do not skip doses to maintain effectiveness.
Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking.
Regular check-ups may be advised to monitor your health and kidney function.
Avoid sudden changes in posture to prevent dizziness.
usageDetails:
How to use RAMIPRES 5MG TABLET
Recommended Timing and Frequency of RAMIPRES 5MG TABLET

RAMIPRES 5MG TABLET is typically taken once daily, preferably at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in the bloodstream.

Some patients may be advised to take it in the morning, while others may benefit from an evening dose depending on their condition and treatment plan. It is important to follow your doctor’s instructions carefully and not alter the timing or frequency without consulting them.

Who Decides the Right Dosage for You?

The dosage of RAMIPRES 5MG TABLET is determined by your healthcare provider based on your medical history, current health status, and response to therapy. It’s important to have an open discussion with your doctor before starting or adjusting your medication.

Should RAMIPRES 5MG TABLET Be Taken With Food?

introduction:
Introduction About ENVAS 10MG TABLET

ENVAS 10MG TABLET contains Enalapril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty breathing, swollen ankles and feet, or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity).

Before taking ENVAS 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you are on a low-salt diet, have diabetes, or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

ENVAS 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure) and in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking ENVAS 10MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with ENVAS 10MG TABLET.

ENVAS 10MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol, as it could aggravate your dizziness.

ENVAS 10MG TABLET may reduce your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels during the therapy to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Other most common side effects of taking ENVAS 10MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, tiredness, and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ENVAS 10MG TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How ENVAS 10MG TABLET Works

ENVAS 10MG TABLET effectively reduces blood pressure and signs of heart failure. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles, which reduces strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart failure.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking ENVAS 10MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ENVAS 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines, such as:

Racecadotril (a medicine used to manage diarrhea)
Medicines that supplement potassium to the body (Ex. spironolactone, triamterene, or amiloride)
Trimethoprim containing antibiotics (used for infections)
Medicines used to manage organ transplant rejection (Ex. ciclosporin, temsirolimus, sirolimus, and everolimus)
Heparin (used to manage blood clots)
Medicines used for heart conditions such as hypertension, chest pain, irregular heartbeats, or heart failure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, furosemide, bumetanide, nitroglycerin, valsartan, aliskiren, procainamide, sacubitril/valsartan)
Lithium (a medicine used in some types of mental illness)
Tricyclic antidepressants (used to manage depression) Ex. amitriptyline
Antipsychotics (used to manage serious mental illnesses) Ex. clozapine, risperidone
Anesthetics (used to manage pain during surgery) Ex. propofol, thiopental
Medicines used to relieve pain (Ex. morphine, aspirin, ibuprofen, celecoxib)
Thrombolytics (used to dissolve blood clots) Ex. reteplase, tenecteplase
Gold therapy (to manage rheumatic conditions)
Medicines used to suppress cough (such as dextromethorphan, guaiphenesin, and pseudoephedrine)
Anti-diabetic medicines and insulin (used to lower the blood glucose level) Ex. vildagliptin, metformin

Introduction About DILVAS 5MG TABLET

DILVAS 5MG TABLET contains Enalapril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty breathing, swollen ankles and feet, or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity).

Before taking DILVAS 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you are on a low-salt diet, have diabetes, or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

DILVAS 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure) and in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking DILVAS 5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with DILVAS 5MG TABLET.

DILVAS 5MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol, as it could aggravate your dizziness.

DILVAS 5MG TABLET may reduce your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels during the therapy to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Other most common side effects of taking DILVAS 5MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, tiredness, and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Manage heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How DILVAS 5MG TABLET Works

DILVAS 5MG TABLET effectively reduces blood pressure and signs of heart failure. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles, which reduces strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart failure.

How to use DILVAS 5MG TABLET

Take DILVAS 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. DILVAS 5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking DILVAS 5MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About COVERSYL 4MG TABLET

COVERSYL 4MG TABLET contains Perindopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension in adults. Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against blood vessel walls is too high. Symptoms of hypertension includes early morning headaches, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, feeling overtiredness, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, and chest pain. It is also used to manage heart failure (a condition where the pumping of heart is inadequate to meet body’s need which is characterized by shortness of breath, fatigue, fast heartbeat.). It also reduces the risk of cardiac events such as heart attack in patients with stable coronary artery disease (a condition where the blood supply to the heart is reduced or blocked resulting in pain or discomfort in chest, arms or shoulders; weakness, light-headedness and feeling sick), in patients who have the history of heart attack and/or an operation to improve blood supply to heart.

Perindopril works by inhibiting the activity of an enzyme called angiotensin converting enzyme (an enzyme which is responsible for causing constriction of blood vessels), resulting in easy flow of blood around the body. Your doctor may check your kidney function, blood pressure, and the amount of electrolytes (Ex. potassium) in your body prior to the management or at regular intervals along with the management.

COVERSYL 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney artery stenosis.  COVERSYL 4MG TABLET should be used in caution with patient having aortic stenosis, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, diabetes, liver, and kidney problems or under dialysis. If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. COVERSYL 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years. The most common side effects of taking COVERSYL 4MG TABLET are low blood pressure, headache, dizziness, muscle cramps, shortness of breath, cough and headache. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

Introduction About HOPACE 2.5 TABLET

HOPACE 2.5 TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of compounds known as Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors. This medication is generally prescribed under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner for cardiovascular health support and blood pressure management.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with the medicine.

HOPACE 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding women, consult your doctor for advice before taking HOPACE 2.5 TABLET. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects of taking HOPACE 2.5 TABLET are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea or skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How HOPACE 2.5 TABLET Works
1. Role of ACE Inhibition in HOPACE 2.5 TABLET

HOPACE 2.5 TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. These medicines work by gently blocking the enzyme called Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme (ACE). This enzyme plays a part in narrowing blood vessels. By inhibiting ACE, HOPACE 2.5 TABLET helps blood vessels stay relaxed and open, allowing blood to flow more freely. This supports the body’s natural process of maintaining balanced blood pressure levels.

2. How HOPACE 2.5 TABLET affects blood flow and vessel function

By helping blood vessels relax, HOPACE 2.5 TABLET improves blood flow throughout the body. This eases of blood flow reduces the effort the heart needs to pump blood, which supports overall cardiovascular health. When blood vessels work efficiently, organs and tissues receive the oxygen and nutrients they need to function well.

3. Ramipril and its interaction with the cardiovascular system

Ramipril influences the cardiovascular system by targeting the renin-angiotensin system, which regulates blood vessel constriction and fluid balance. By balancing this system, ramipril encourages healthier vessel function and supports the regulation of fluid levels in the body, which can influence blood pressure and heart workload.

4. How HOPACE 2.5 TABLET supports natural blood pressure regulation

HOPACE 2.5 TABLET assists the body’s natural mechanisms to regulate blood pressure without abrupt changes. This gradual support helps to maintain steady blood pressure, which is important for reducing stress on the heart and blood vessels over time. Using HOPACE 2.5 TABLET as directed under medical supervision helps promote this balanced approach to cardiovascular health.

Introduction About ENAPRIL 2.5MG TABLET

ENAPRIL 2.5MG TABLET contains Enalapril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty breathing, swollen ankles and feet, or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity).

Before taking ENAPRIL 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you are on a low-salt diet, have diabetes, or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

ENAPRIL 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure) and in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking ENAPRIL 2.5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with ENAPRIL 2.5MG TABLET.

ENAPRIL 2.5MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol, as it could aggravate your dizziness.

ENAPRIL 2.5MG TABLET may reduce your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels during the therapy to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Other most common side effects of taking ENAPRIL 2.5MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, tiredness, and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles, which reduces strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart failure.

introduction:
Introduction About TELVILITE 40 TABLET

TELVILITE 40 TABLET is used to manage essential hypertension. It contains Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin II receptor antagonists. It is also used to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events such as heart attack or stroke in adults who are known to have a reduced or blocked blood supply to the heart or legs and had a stroke or with a high risk of diabetes. TELVILITE 40 TABLET makes blood vessels to relax and thus lowers the blood pressure by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (substance produced in your body which causes narrowing of blood vessels).

Your doctor may check the kidney function test, blood pressure and the amount of electrolytes (Ex. potassium) in body prior to the management or at regular intervals during management with this medicine. TELVILITE 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (flow of bile from liver stops or slows). TELVILITE 40 TABLET should be used with caution in patients having diabetes, kidney disease, heart problems and raised aldosterone levels.

TELVILITE 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in early pregnancy and must not be taken by women who are pregnant for more than 3 months and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TELVILITE 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (up to the age of 18 years) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effect of taking TELVILITE 40 TABLET is low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if the side effects worsen or persists for a longer period.

Introduction About RAMCOR 2.5MG CAPSULE

RAMCOR 2.5MG CAPSULE contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of compounds known as Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors. This medication is generally prescribed under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner for cardiovascular health support and blood pressure management.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with the medicine.

RAMCOR 2.5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding women, consult your doctor for advice before taking RAMCOR 2.5MG CAPSULE. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects of taking RAMCOR 2.5MG CAPSULE are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea or skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMCOR 2.5MG CAPSULE Works
1. Role of ACE Inhibition in RAMCOR 2.5MG CAPSULE

RAMCOR 2.5MG CAPSULE contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. These medicines work by gently blocking the enzyme called Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme (ACE). This enzyme plays a part in narrowing blood vessels. By inhibiting ACE, RAMCOR 2.5MG CAPSULE helps blood vessels stay relaxed and open, allowing blood to flow more freely. This supports the body’s natural process of maintaining balanced blood pressure levels.

2. How RAMCOR 2.5MG CAPSULE affects blood flow and vessel function

By helping blood vessels relax, RAMCOR 2.5MG CAPSULE improves blood flow throughout the body. This eases of blood flow reduces the effort the heart needs to pump blood, which supports overall cardiovascular health. When blood vessels work efficiently, organs and tissues receive the oxygen and nutrients they need to function well.

3. Ramipril and its interaction with the cardiovascular system

Ramipril influences the cardiovascular system by targeting the renin-angiotensin system, which regulates blood vessel constriction and fluid balance. By balancing this system, ramipril encourages healthier vessel function and supports the regulation of fluid levels in the body, which can influence blood pressure and heart workload.

4. How RAMCOR 2.5MG CAPSULE supports natural blood pressure regulation

RAMCOR 2.5MG CAPSULE assists the body’s natural mechanisms to regulate blood pressure without abrupt changes. This gradual support helps to maintain steady blood pressure, which is important for reducing stress on the heart and blood vessels over time. Using RAMCOR 2.5MG CAPSULE as directed under medical supervision helps promote this balanced approach to cardiovascular health.

Introduction About STARACE 2.5 TABLET

STARACE 2.5 TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of compounds known as Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors. This medication is generally prescribed under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner for cardiovascular health support and blood pressure management.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with the medicine.

STARACE 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding women, consult your doctor for advice before taking STARACE 2.5 TABLET. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects of taking STARACE 2.5 TABLET are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea or skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How STARACE 2.5 TABLET Works
1. Role of ACE Inhibition in STARACE 2.5 TABLET

STARACE 2.5 TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. These medicines work by gently blocking the enzyme called Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme (ACE). This enzyme plays a part in narrowing blood vessels. By inhibiting ACE, STARACE 2.5 TABLET helps blood vessels stay relaxed and open, allowing blood to flow more freely. This supports the body’s natural process of maintaining balanced blood pressure levels.

2. How STARACE 2.5 TABLET affects blood flow and vessel function

By helping blood vessels relax, STARACE 2.5 TABLET improves blood flow throughout the body. This eases of blood flow reduces the effort the heart needs to pump blood, which supports overall cardiovascular health. When blood vessels work efficiently, organs and tissues receive the oxygen and nutrients they need to function well.

3. Ramipril and its interaction with the cardiovascular system

Ramipril influences the cardiovascular system by targeting the renin-angiotensin system, which regulates blood vessel constriction and fluid balance. By balancing this system, ramipril encourages healthier vessel function and supports the regulation of fluid levels in the body, which can influence blood pressure and heart workload.

4. How STARACE 2.5 TABLET supports natural blood pressure regulation

STARACE 2.5 TABLET assists the body’s natural mechanisms to regulate blood pressure without abrupt changes. This gradual support helps to maintain steady blood pressure, which is important for reducing stress on the heart and blood vessels over time. Using STARACE 2.5 TABLET as directed under medical supervision helps promote this balanced approach to cardiovascular health.

introduction:
Introduction About ENAPRIL HT TABLET

ENAPRIL HT TABLET is a combination of Enalapril and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used in the management of hypertension (high blood pressure). It is typically used in patients who have not responded adequately to therapy with either of the single agents.

Before taking ENAPRIL HT TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or severe dehydration as a precaution.

ENAPRIL HT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension or severe kidney problems. It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects.

During management with ENAPRIL HT TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking ENAPRIL HT TABLET are headache, dizziness, tiredness, low blood pressure, muscle cramps, low blood sugar levels and increased blood cholesterol and potassium levels. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ENAPRIL HT TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How ENAPRIL HT TABLET Works

ENAPRIL HT TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use ENAPRIL HT TABLET

Take ENAPRIL HT TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. ENAPRIL HT TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Continue to take ENAPRIL HT TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.
