Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking ENAPRIL HT TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ENAPRIL HT TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure and make you feel dizzier or faint.

ENAPRIL HT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment (including dialysis). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems (including kidney transplantation or renal artery stenosis). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ENAPRIL HT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ENAPRIL HT TABLET if you are allergic to Hydrochlorothiazide, Enalapril or to any other ACE inhibitor (such as captopril lisinopril, ramipril).

ENAPRIL HT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma. It should also be used with caution among patients who previously developed any breathing problems following the consumption of this medicine. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ENAPRIL HT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (such as ischemic heart disease (low oxygen supply to heart muscles), heart block, narrowing of heart valves, heart failure etc.). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About CARDACE H 10 TABLET

CARDACE H 10 TABLET is a combination of Ramipril and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors and Diuretics respectively. It is used in the management of essential hypertension.

Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke.

Before taking CARDACE H 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. Inform your doctor if you have any problems related to kidney, liver, lungs or heart and if you have other conditions such as diabetes, gout, myopia, glaucoma, collagen vascular disease or parathyroid disease.

CARDACE H 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents less than 18 years of age. If you are taking any other medicines for other conditions or if you have history of allergy, inform to your doctor as it may manage drug-related interactions and serious side effect.

The most common side effect of CARDACE H 10 TABLET are headache, dizziness, stomach pain, tiredness and nausea. Consult your doctor for advice if your symptoms get worsen over the time.
uses: Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CARDACE H 10 TABLET
Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How CARDACE H 10 TABLET Works

CARDACE H 10 TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where Ramipril works by inhibiting the activity of an enzyme called Angiotensin converting enzyme (an enzyme which is responsible for causing constriction of blood vessels) which enhances easy flow of blood around the body. Hydrochlorothiazide works by decreasing the extra fluid volume also works by managing reabsorption of sodium in the kidneys, which in turn it relaxes the blood vessels and makes the blood flow more easily in the passage of blood vessels and thus lowers the blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use CARDACE H 10 TABLET

Always take CARDACE H 10 TABLET as directed by your physician. Take this medicine with or without food, swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition.

CARDACE H 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment, renal artery stenosis or patients undergoing dialysis. Consult your doctor for advice before taking CARDACE H 10 TABLET.

CARDACE H 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with low or unstable blood pressure and it should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Consult your doctor for advice before taking CARDACE H 10 TABLET.

Others

CARDACE H 10 TABLET is not recommended for you, if you have:

Difficulty urination
Personal or family history of angioedema
Electrolyte disturbances

Before taking CARDACE H 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Diabetes
Scleroderma or systemic lupus erythematosus
Dehydration problems
Upcoming major surgery including dental surgery which requires anaesthesia for numbness or sedation
Personal or family history of skin cancer
High levels of potassium in the blood
Acute myopia and secondary angle-closure glaucoma
Parathyroid disease
Gout or increased levels of uric acid in the blood
Raynaud’s phenomenon (condition resulting from poor circulation in the extremities, such as fingers and toes)

Use in pediatrics:

CARDACE H 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents less than 18 years of age. Consult with your doctor for advice before taking CARDACE H 10 TABLET.

Use in geriatrics:

CARDACE H 10 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age, usually initiating the management with the lowest effective. Consult with your doctor for advice before taking CARDACE H 10 TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About ENAM 10MG TABLET

ENAM 10MG TABLET contains Enalapril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty breathing, swollen ankles and feet, or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity).

Before taking ENAM 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you are on a low-salt diet, have diabetes, or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

ENAM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure) and in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking ENAM 10MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with ENAM 10MG TABLET.

ENAM 10MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol, as it could aggravate your dizziness.

ENAM 10MG TABLET may reduce your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels during the therapy to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Other most common side effects of taking ENAM 10MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, tiredness, and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ENAM 10MG TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How ENAM 10MG TABLET Works

ENAM 10MG TABLET effectively reduces blood pressure and signs of heart failure. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles, which reduces strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart failure.
usageDetails:

Take ENAM 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. ENAM 10MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking ENAM 10MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Introduction About CARDACE 5MG TABLET

CARDACE 5MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the category of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. This tablet is often considered by healthcare professionals for maintaining heart and vascular health like hypertension and heart failure. It is a prescription-only medication and must be used under medical supervision.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Also might advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with CARDACE 5MG TABLET.

CARDACE 5MG TABLET is not advisable for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, inform your doctor for advice before taking CARDACE 5MG TABLET. It is not considered for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How CARDACE 5MG TABLET Works

CARDACE 5MG TABLET decreases blood pressure by reducing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). CARDACE 5MG TABLET distributes well amongst your body tissues. Which in turn, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

How to use CARDACE 5MG TABLET
Recommended Timing and Frequency of CARDACE 5MG TABLET

CARDACE 5MG TABLET is typically taken once daily, preferably at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in the bloodstream.

Some patients may be advised to take it in the morning, while others may benefit from an evening dose depending on their condition and treatment plan. It is important to follow your doctor’s instructions carefully and not alter the timing or frequency without consulting them.

Who Decides the Right Dosage for You?

The dosage of CARDACE 5MG TABLET is determined by your healthcare provider based on your medical history, current health status, and response to therapy. It’s important to have an open discussion with your doctor before starting or adjusting your medication.

Should CARDACE 5MG TABLET Be Taken With Food?

CARDACE 5MG TABLET can generally be taken with or without food. Taking it with meals may help reduce occasional stomach discomfort. It’s best to maintain a consistent routine by taking the tablet at the same time each day to support steady blood levels of the medicine.

General Administration Instructions
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water.
Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to ensure proper absorption.
Follow the exact dosage and schedule prescribed by your healthcare provider.
Things to Remember While Using CARDACE 5MG TABLET
Do not skip doses to maintain effectiveness.
Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking.
Regular check-ups may be advised to monitor your health and kidney function.
Avoid sudden changes in posture to prevent dizziness.
Importance of Following Your Doctor’s Schedule

Adhering to the prescribed schedule helps in maintaining stable blood pressure and reduces strain on the heart. Any changes in dosage or frequency should be made only under medical supervision.

Introduction About ENAPRIL 5MG TABLET

ENAPRIL 5MG TABLET contains Enalapril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty breathing, swollen ankles and feet, or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity).

Before taking ENAPRIL 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you are on a low-salt diet, have diabetes, or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

ENAPRIL 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure) and in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking ENAPRIL 5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with ENAPRIL 5MG TABLET.

ENAPRIL 5MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol, as it could aggravate your dizziness.

ENAPRIL 5MG TABLET may reduce your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels during the therapy to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Other most common side effects of taking ENAPRIL 5MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, tiredness, and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ENAPRIL 5MG TABLET Works

ENAPRIL 5MG TABLET effectively reduces blood pressure and signs of heart failure. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles, which reduces strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart failure.

Take ENAPRIL 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. ENAPRIL 5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking ENAPRIL 5MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to ensure proper absorption.
Follow the exact dosage and schedule prescribed by your healthcare provider.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with the medicine.

RAMI RACE 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMI RACE 2.5 TABLET Works
1. Role of ACE Inhibition in RAMI RACE 2.5 TABLET

RAMI RACE 2.5 TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. These medicines work by gently blocking the enzyme called Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme (ACE). This enzyme plays a part in narrowing blood vessels. By inhibiting ACE, RAMI RACE 2.5 TABLET helps blood vessels stay relaxed and open, allowing blood to flow more freely. This supports the body’s natural process of maintaining balanced blood pressure levels.

2. How RAMI RACE 2.5 TABLET affects blood flow and vessel function

By helping blood vessels relax, RAMI RACE 2.5 TABLET improves blood flow throughout the body. This eases of blood flow reduces the effort the heart needs to pump blood, which supports overall cardiovascular health. When blood vessels work efficiently, organs and tissues receive the oxygen and nutrients they need to function well.

3. Ramipril and its interaction with the cardiovascular system

Ramipril influences the cardiovascular system by targeting the renin-angiotensin system, which regulates blood vessel constriction and fluid balance. By balancing this system, ramipril encourages healthier vessel function and supports the regulation of fluid levels in the body, which can influence blood pressure and heart workload.

4. How RAMI RACE 2.5 TABLET supports natural blood pressure regulation

RAMI RACE 2.5 TABLET assists the body’s natural mechanisms to regulate blood pressure without abrupt changes. This gradual support helps to maintain steady blood pressure, which is important for reducing stress on the heart and blood vessels over time. Using RAMI RACE 2.5 TABLET as directed under medical supervision helps promote this balanced approach to cardiovascular health.

introduction:
Introduction About RAMISTAR 1.25MG TABLET

RAMISTAR 1.25MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension). Blood pressure is the force exerted by the circulating blood on the walls of blood vessels. Hypertension is a condition in which the blood pressure is too high.

RAMISTAR 1.25MG TABLET reduces the risk of kidney problems and can be used as a management following a heart attack. RAMISTAR 1.25MG TABLET is also used to manage heart failure (a condition when the heart is not able to pump enough blood). Symptoms include headache, breathlessness, excess sweating, sleep disturbance, tingling and dizziness.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with RAMISTAR 1.25MG TABLET.

RAMISTAR 1.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking RAMISTAR 1.25MG TABLET. RAMISTAR 1.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMISTAR 1.25MG TABLET Works

RAMISTAR 1.25MG TABLET decreases blood pressure by decreasing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). RAMISTAR 1.25MG TABLET distributes extensively amongst your body tissues. As a result, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

introduction:
Introduction About LIPRIL 10MG TABLET

LIPRIL 10MG TABLET contains Lisinopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty in breathing, swollen ankles and feet or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity) and can reduce kidney damage in diabetic patients who have high blood pressure.

Before taking LIPRIL 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

LIPRIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking LIPRIL 10MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with LIPRIL 10MG TABLET.

LIPRIL 10MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate your dizziness.

Other most common side effects of taking LIPRIL 10MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, nausea and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How LIPRIL 10MG TABLET Works

LIPRIL 10MG TABLET is an ACE inhibitor. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE), that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart and the kidneys. This reduces strain on the heart and kidneys, improves their functions and manages the risks of heart failure or kidney damage.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking LIPRIL 10MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

If you accidentally become pregnant while undergoing therapy with LIPRIL 10MG TABLET, stop taking this medicine and inform your doctor immediately.
LIPRIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
LIPRIL 10MG TABLET may make you feel tired or dizzy. Therefore, do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines as a precaution.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking LIPRIL 10MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure and make you feel dizzier or faint

LIPRIL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (including narrowing or blood vessels supplying the kidneys, dialysis or kidney transplantation). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
LIPRIL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take LIPRIL 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to Lisinopril or to any other ACE inhibitors (such as captopril, enalapril, ramipril).

LIPRIL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems apart from hypertension and heart failure (such as irregular heartbeat, heart valve disease or enlarged heart). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

LIPRIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have diabetes with impaired kidney functions

Before taking LIPRIL 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have hypotension (low blood pressure)
Have stroke or mini stroke
Are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness such as vomiting or diarrhea
Have diabetes
Have any autoimmune disease that affects the skin or collagen (Ex. lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis, or scleroderma)
Are scheduled for any upcoming surgery (including minor dental surgery)
Are scheduled for LDL apheresis (a procedure used to remove cholesterol from the blood)
Have any desensitization management (used to reduce the effect of an allergy to bee or wasp stings)
Have high levels of potassium in the blood

Use in paediatrics:

LIPRIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) unless prescribed by a physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before consumption.

Use in geriatrics:

LIPRIL 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking LIPRIL 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Racecadotril (a medicine used to manage diarrhea)
Medicines that supplement potassium to the body (Ex. spironolactone, triamterene or amiloride)
Trimethoprim containing antibiotics (used for infections)
Medicines used to manage organ transplant rejection (Ex. ciclosporin, temsirolimus, sirolimus, everolimus)
Heparin (used to manage blood clots)
Medicines used for heart conditions such as hypertension, chest pain, irregular heartbeats or heart failure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, furosemide, bumetanide, nitroglycerin, valsartan, aliskiren, procainamide, sacubitril/valsartan)
Lithium (a medicine used in some types of mental illness)
Tricyclic antidepressants (used to manage depression) Ex. amitriptyline
Antipsychotics (used to manage serious mental illnesses) Ex. clozapine, risperidone
Anesthetics (used to manage pain during surgery) Ex. propofol, thiopental, lidocaine
Medicines used to relieve pain (Ex. morphine, aspirin, ibuprofen, celecoxib, valdecoxib)
Gold therapy (used to manage rheumatic conditions)
Medicines used to suppress cough (such as dextromethorphan, guaiphenesin, pseudoephedrine)
Anti-diabetic medicines and insulin (used to lower the blood glucose level) Ex. vildagliptin, metformin, gliclazide
Allopurinol (a medicine used to reduce blood uric acid levels)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more LIPRIL 10MG TABLET, contact your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include severe dizziness or light-headedness with fainting, fast heartbeat, anxiety, cough and fast breathing.

introduction:
Introduction About PERIACE 4MG TABLET

PERIACE 4MG TABLET contains Perindopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension in adults. Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against blood vessel walls is too high. Symptoms of hypertension includes early morning headaches, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, feeling overtiredness, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, and chest pain. It is also used to manage heart failure (a condition where the pumping of heart is inadequate to meet body’s need which is characterized by shortness of breath, fatigue, fast heartbeat.). It also reduces the risk of cardiac events such as heart attack in patients with stable coronary artery disease (a condition where the blood supply to the heart is reduced or blocked resulting in pain or discomfort in chest, arms or shoulders; weakness, light-headedness and feeling sick), in patients who have the history of heart attack and/or an operation to improve blood supply to heart.

Perindopril works by inhibiting the activity of an enzyme called angiotensin converting enzyme (an enzyme which is responsible for causing constriction of blood vessels), resulting in easy flow of blood around the body. Your doctor may check your kidney function, blood pressure, and the amount of electrolytes (Ex. potassium) in your body prior to the management or at regular intervals along with the management.

PERIACE 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney artery stenosis.  PERIACE 4MG TABLET should be used in caution with patient having aortic stenosis, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, diabetes, liver, and kidney problems or under dialysis. If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. PERIACE 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years. The most common side effects of taking PERIACE 4MG TABLET are low blood pressure, headache, dizziness, muscle cramps, shortness of breath, cough and headache. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

name: Ramipres 10mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About RAMIPRES 10MG TABLET

RAMIPRES 10MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension). Blood pressure is the force exerted by the circulating blood on the walls of blood vessels. Hypertension is a condition in which the blood pressure is too high.

RAMIPRES 10MG TABLET reduces the risk of kidney problems and can be used as a management following a heart attack. RAMIPRES 10MG TABLET is also used to manage heart failure (a condition when the heart is not able to pump enough blood). Symptoms include headache, breathlessness, excess sweating, sleep disturbance, tingling and dizziness.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with RAMIPRES 10MG TABLET.

RAMIPRES 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking RAMIPRES 10MG TABLET. RAMIPRES 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.
uses: Manage increased blood pressure, heart failure
Manage and reduces the risk of getting a heart attack or stroke and slow down the worsening of kidney problems
usesDetails:
Uses Of RAMIPRES 10MG TABLET
Manage increased blood pressure, heart failure
Manage and reduces the risk of getting a heart attack or stroke and slow down the worsening of kidney problems
mechanismOfAction:
How RAMIPRES 10MG TABLET Works

RAMIPRES 10MG TABLET decreases blood pressure by decreasing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). RAMIPRES 10MG TABLET distributes extensively amongst your body tissues. As a result, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.
usageDetails:
How to use RAMIPRES 10MG TABLET

Take RAMIPRES 10MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET

CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Lisinopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and certain type of angina (chest pain) called as Prinzmetal or variant angina. It can also be used to manage heart failure and reduce the chances of hospitalization among the heart patients.

It also protects the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

Before taking CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension, angina and heart failure (such as cardiogenic shock or narrowing of heart valves).

Talk to your doctor if you are on a low salt diet or have diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea) before taking CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET as a precaution.

CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure). It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects.

The most common side effects of taking CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET are dizziness, swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation and muscle cramps. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Protects kidney functions in patients with hypertension and diabetes

mechanismOfAction:
How CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET Works

CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs (such as kidneys). This improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces strain on the heart.

It also allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It can improve blood supply to the kidneys which helps in improving kidney functions among diabetic patients. As a result, it reduces blood pressure and improves the functions of the heart and the kidneys.
usageDetails:
How to use CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET

Take CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Continue to take CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

warnings.details: CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing fetus. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. If you accidentally become pregnant while undergoing therapy with CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor immediately.
CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure and make you feel dizzier or faint.

CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment (including dialysis or narrowing or renal arteries). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems (including kidney transplantation). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine, Lisinopril or to any other calcium antagonists (such as nifedipine, diltiazem) or ACE inhibitors (such as captopril, enalapril).

CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have diabetes with impaired kidney functions

Before taking CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have problems in the blood vessels supplying the brain
Are on a salt-restricted diet
Are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness such as vomiting or diarrhea
Have low WBC, RBC and platelet count in the blood
Have diabetes
Have any autoimmune disease that affects the skin or collagen (Ex. lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis or scleroderma)
Are scheduled for any upcoming surgery
Are scheduled for LDL apheresis (a procedure to remove cholesterol from the blood)
Have any desensitization management (used to reduce the effect of an allergy to bee or wasp stings)
Have high blood potassium levels
Previously had stroke or mini stroke

Use in Paediatrics:

CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET can be used in children and adolescents (aged between 6-18 years) if prescribed by a physician. It is not recommended for use in children aged below 6 years. Therefore, consult your doctor before consumption.

Use in Geriatrics:

CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Medicines that supplement potassium to the body (Ex. spironolactone, triamterene or amiloride)

Medicines used to manage organ transplant rejection (Ex. ciclosporin, temsirolimus, sirolimus, everolimus)
Heparin (used to manage blood clots)
Medicines used for heart conditions such as hypertension, chest pain, irregular heartbeats or heart failure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, furosemide, bumetanide, nitroglycerin, valsartan, aliskiren, procainamide, sacubitril/valsartan)
Lithium (a medicine used in some types of mental illness)
Tricyclic antidepressants (used to manage depression) Ex. amitriptyline

Anesthetics (used to manage pain during surgery) Ex. propofol, thiopental, proparacaine, lignocaine
Medicines used to relieve pain (Ex. morphine, aspirin, ibuprofen, celecoxib, valdecoxib)
Thrombolytics (used to dissolve blood clots) Ex. reteplase, tenecteplase
Gold therapy (used to manage rheumatic conditions)
Medicines used to suppress cough (such as dextromethorphan, guaiphenesin, pseudoephedrine)
Anti-diabetic medicines and insulin (used to lower the blood glucose level) Ex. vildagliptin, metformin
Other medicines used to manage high blood pressure or angina (Ex. diltiazem, verapamil)

Ritonavir, indinavir, nelfinavir (used in management of HIV infections)

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET, as it could reduce your blood pressure to an abnormal level.

If you or anyone else accidentally took more CALCHEK L 2.5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include dizziness, fainting, light-headedness, weakness, shock, cool or clampy skin, fast heartbeat, anxiety, cough and shortness of breath.

How CARDACE METO 2.5/25MG TABLET Works

Ramipril is an ACE inhibitor. It blocks the effects of certain enzymes in the body (such as angiotensin converting enzyme (ACE)) that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

Collectively, blocking the actions of adrenaline and ACE reduces the strain on the heart and relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and the kidneys, which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to them and reduces blood pressure and kidney damage.

introduction:
Introduction About CARDACE AM 2.5 TABLET

CARDACE AM 2.5 TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Ramipril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and certain type of angina (chest pain) called as Prinzmetal or variant angina. It can also be used to manage heart failure and reduce the chances of hospitalization among the heart patients.

It also protects the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

Before taking CARDACE AM 2.5 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension, angina and heart failure (such as cardiogenic shock or narrowing of heart valves).

Talk to your doctor if you are on a low salt diet or have diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea) before taking CARDACE AM 2.5 TABLET as a precaution.

CARDACE AM 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure). It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects.

The most common side effects of taking CARDACE AM 2.5 TABLET are dizziness, swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation and muscle cramps. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CARDACE AM 2.5 TABLET Works

CARDACE AM 2.5 TABLET is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs (such as kidneys). This improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces strain on the heart.

It also allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It can improve blood supply to the kidneys which helps in delaying the worsening of kidney functions in diabetic patients. As a result, it reduces blood pressure and improves the functions of the heart and the kidneys.
usageDetails:
How to use CARDACE AM 2.5 TABLET

Take CARDACE AM 2.5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. CARDACE AM 2.5 TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Continue to take CARDACE AM 2.5 TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About CARDACE AM 5 TABLET

CARDACE AM 5 TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Ramipril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and certain type of angina (chest pain) called as Prinzmetal or variant angina. It can also be used to manage heart failure and reduce the chances of hospitalization among the heart patients.

It also protects the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

Before taking CARDACE AM 5 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension, angina and heart failure (such as cardiogenic shock or narrowing of heart valves).

Talk to your doctor if you are on a low salt diet or have diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea) before taking CARDACE AM 5 TABLET as a precaution.

CARDACE AM 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure). It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects.

The most common side effects of taking CARDACE AM 5 TABLET are dizziness, swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation and muscle cramps. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CARDACE AM 5 TABLET Works

CARDACE AM 5 TABLET is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs (such as kidneys). This improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces strain on the heart.

It also allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It can improve blood supply to the kidneys which helps in delaying the worsening of kidney functions in diabetic patients. As a result, it reduces blood pressure and improves the functions of the heart and the kidneys.
usageDetails:
How to use CARDACE AM 5 TABLET

Take CARDACE AM 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. CARDACE AM 5 TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Continue to take CARDACE AM 5 TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Therefore, inform your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. If you accidentally become pregnant while undergoing therapy with CARDACE AM 5 TABLET, inform your doctor immediately.
CARDACE AM 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking CARDACE AM 5 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CARDACE AM 5 TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure and make you feel dizzier or faint.

CARDACE AM 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment (including dialysis or narrowing or renal arteries). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems (including kidney transplantation). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
CARDACE AM 5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Do not take CARDACE AM 5 TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine, Ramipril or to any other calcium antagonists (such as nifedipine, diltiazem) or ACE inhibitors (such as captopril, lisinopril, enalapril).

CARDACE AM 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

CARDACE AM 5 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have diabetes with impaired kidney functions

Before taking CARDACE AM 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have problems in the blood vessels supplying the brain
Are on a salt-restricted diet
Are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness such as vomiting or diarrhea
Have low WBC, RBC and platelet count in the blood
Have diabetes
Have any autoimmune disease that affects the skin or collagen (Ex. lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis or scleroderma)
Are scheduled for any upcoming surgery
Have any desensitization management (used to reduce the effect of an allergy to bee or wasp stings)
Have high blood potassium levels

Use in Paediatrics:

CARDACE AM 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor before consumption.

Use in Geriatrics:

CARDACE AM 5 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About ZIRAM 5MG TABLET

ZIRAM 5MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the category of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. This tablet is often considered by healthcare professionals for maintaining heart and vascular health like hypertension and heart failure. It is a prescription-only medication and must be used under medical supervision.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Also might advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with ZIRAM 5MG TABLET.

ZIRAM 5MG TABLET is not advisable for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, inform your doctor for advice before taking ZIRAM 5MG TABLET. It is not considered for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZIRAM 5MG TABLET Works

ZIRAM 5MG TABLET decreases blood pressure by reducing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). ZIRAM 5MG TABLET distributes well amongst your body tissues. Which in turn, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

How to use ZIRAM 5MG TABLET
Recommended Timing and Frequency of ZIRAM 5MG TABLET

ZIRAM 5MG TABLET is typically taken once daily, preferably at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in the bloodstream.

Some patients may be advised to take it in the morning, while others may benefit from an evening dose depending on their condition and treatment plan. It is important to follow your doctor’s instructions carefully and not alter the timing or frequency without consulting them.

Who Decides the Right Dosage for You?

The dosage of ZIRAM 5MG TABLET is determined by your healthcare provider based on your medical history, current health status, and response to therapy. It’s important to have an open discussion with your doctor before starting or adjusting your medication.

Should ZIRAM 5MG TABLET Be Taken With Food?

ZIRAM 5MG TABLET can generally be taken with or without food. Taking it with meals may help reduce occasional stomach discomfort. It’s best to maintain a consistent routine by taking the tablet at the same time each day to support steady blood levels of the medicine.

General Administration Instructions
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water.
Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to ensure proper absorption.
Follow the exact dosage and schedule prescribed by your healthcare provider.
Things to Remember While Using ZIRAM 5MG TABLET
Do not skip doses to maintain effectiveness.
Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking.
Regular check-ups may be advised to monitor your health and kidney function.
Avoid sudden changes in posture to prevent dizziness.
Importance of Following Your Doctor’s Schedule

Adhering to the prescribed schedule helps in maintaining stable blood pressure and reduces strain on the heart. Any changes in dosage or frequency should be made only under medical supervision.

How Long Do Initial Effects Usually Last?

After starting ZIRAM 5MG TABLET, some individuals may notice initial changes such as mild dizziness or tiredness. These effects are generally temporary and often improve within a few days to a couple of weeks as the body adjusts to the medication.

It’s important to continue taking the medicine as prescribed, even if you experience mild effects early on. If any effects persist beyond a few weeks or cause discomfort, you should consult your healthcare provider for guidance.

Remember, the full benefits of ZIRAM 5MG TABLET in supporting heart and blood vessel function may take several weeks of regular use to become apparent, so patience and adherence to your prescribed schedule are key.

More Information
What to Discuss With Your Doctor Before Using ZIRAM 5MG TABLET

Before starting ZIRAM 5MG TABLET, it’s important to have an open conversation with your healthcare provider to ensure safe and effective use. Consider discussing the following points:

Your Medical History: Inform your doctor about any history of kidney or liver problems, heart conditions, or allergies.
Current Medications: Share details of all prescription, over-the-counter medicines, supplements, and herbal products you are taking.
Pregnancy or Breastfeeding: If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, discuss the potential risks and alternatives.
Symptoms to Watch For: Understand which symptoms or side effects require immediate medical attention, such as swelling, severe dizziness, or difficulty breathing.
Lifestyle Factors: Talk about your diet, alcohol use, and any lifestyle habits that may affect your medication’s effectiveness.
Follow-up Plan: Clarify how often you should have check-ups or blood tests to monitor your progress and safety.
Medicines Often Prescribed Alongside ACE Inhibitors

ZIRAM 5MG TABLET belongs to the class of ACE inhibitors commonly used in managing cardiovascular health. Doctors may prescribe additional medicines to complement its effects, such as:

Diuretics (Water Pills): Help reduce excess fluid and support blood pressure control.
Beta-Blockers: Assist in managing heart rate and reducing heart strain.
Calcium Channel Blockers: Help relax blood vessels and improve blood flow.
Statins: Used to manage cholesterol levels as part of overall heart health.

Beyond ACE inhibitors like ZIRAM 5MG TABLET, cardiac care often involves a variety of tablets tailored to support heart function and circulation, including:

Antiplatelet agents to reduce blood clot risks

introduction:
Introduction About NURIL 5MG TABLET

NURIL 5MG TABLET contains Enalapril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty breathing, swollen ankles and feet, or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity).

Before taking NURIL 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you are on a low-salt diet, have diabetes, or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

NURIL 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure) and in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking NURIL 5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with NURIL 5MG TABLET.

NURIL 5MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol, as it could aggravate your dizziness.

NURIL 5MG TABLET may reduce your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels during the therapy to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Other most common side effects of taking NURIL 5MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, tiredness, and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How NURIL 5MG TABLET Works

NURIL 5MG TABLET effectively reduces blood pressure and signs of heart failure. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles, which reduces strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart failure.

Racecadotril (a medicine used to manage diarrhea)
Medicines that supplement potassium to the body (Ex. spironolactone, triamterene, or amiloride)
Trimethoprim containing antibiotics (used for infections)
Medicines used to manage organ transplant rejection (Ex. ciclosporin, temsirolimus, sirolimus, and everolimus)
Heparin (used to manage blood clots)
Medicines used for heart conditions such as hypertension, chest pain, irregular heartbeats, or heart failure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, furosemide, bumetanide, nitroglycerin, valsartan, aliskiren, procainamide, sacubitril/valsartan)
Lithium (a medicine used in some types of mental illness)
Tricyclic antidepressants (used to manage depression) Ex. amitriptyline
Antipsychotics (used to manage serious mental illnesses) Ex. clozapine, risperidone
Anesthetics (used to manage pain during surgery) Ex. propofol, thiopental
Medicines used to relieve pain (Ex. morphine, aspirin, ibuprofen, celecoxib)
Thrombolytics (used to dissolve blood clots) Ex. reteplase, tenecteplase
Gold therapy (to manage rheumatic conditions)
Medicines used to suppress cough (such as dextromethorphan, guaiphenesin, and pseudoephedrine)
Anti-diabetic medicines and insulin (used to lower the blood glucose level) Ex. vildagliptin, metformin
Allopurinol (a medicine used to reduce blood uric acid levels)
Celecoxib and valdecoxib (used to relieve pain and swelling)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more NURIL 5MG TABLET, contact your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include severe dizziness or lightheadedness with fainting, a fast heartbeat, anxiety, coughing, and fast breathing.

Introduction About MACPRIL 5MG TABLET

MACPRIL 5MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the category of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. This tablet is often considered by healthcare professionals for maintaining heart and vascular health like hypertension and heart failure. It is a prescription-only medication and must be used under medical supervision.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Also might advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with MACPRIL 5MG TABLET.

MACPRIL 5MG TABLET is not advisable for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, inform your doctor for advice before taking MACPRIL 5MG TABLET. It is not considered for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

How MACPRIL 5MG TABLET Works

MACPRIL 5MG TABLET decreases blood pressure by reducing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). MACPRIL 5MG TABLET distributes well amongst your body tissues. Which in turn, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

Recommended Timing and Frequency of MACPRIL 5MG TABLET

MACPRIL 5MG TABLET is typically taken once daily, preferably at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in the bloodstream.

Some patients may be advised to take it in the morning, while others may benefit from an evening dose depending on their condition and treatment plan. It is important to follow your doctor’s instructions carefully and not alter the timing or frequency without consulting them.

Who Decides the Right Dosage for You?

The dosage of MACPRIL 5MG TABLET is determined by your healthcare provider based on your medical history, current health status, and response to therapy. It’s important to have an open discussion with your doctor before starting or adjusting your medication.

Should MACPRIL 5MG TABLET Be Taken With Food?

MACPRIL 5MG TABLET can generally be taken with or without food. Taking it with meals may help reduce occasional stomach discomfort. It’s best to maintain a consistent routine by taking the tablet at the same time each day to support steady blood levels of the medicine.

General Administration Instructions
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water.
Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to ensure proper absorption.
Follow the exact dosage and schedule prescribed by your healthcare provider.
Things to Remember While Using MACPRIL 5MG TABLET
Do not skip doses to maintain effectiveness.
Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking.
Regular check-ups may be advised to monitor your health and kidney function.
Avoid sudden changes in posture to prevent dizziness.
Importance of Following Your Doctor’s Schedule

Adhering to the prescribed schedule helps in maintaining stable blood pressure and reduces strain on the heart. Any changes in dosage or frequency should be made only under medical supervision.

Introduction About NURIL 2.5MG TABLET

NURIL 2.5MG TABLET contains Enalapril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty breathing, swollen ankles and feet, or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity).

Before taking NURIL 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you are on a low-salt diet, have diabetes, or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

NURIL 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure) and in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking NURIL 2.5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with NURIL 2.5MG TABLET.

NURIL 2.5MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol, as it could aggravate your dizziness.

NURIL 2.5MG TABLET may reduce your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels during the therapy to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Other most common side effects of taking NURIL 2.5MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, tiredness, and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How NURIL 2.5MG TABLET Works

NURIL 2.5MG TABLET effectively reduces blood pressure and signs of heart failure. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles, which reduces strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart failure.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking NURIL 2.5MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Introduction About CALCHEK L 5MG TABLET

CALCHEK L 5MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Lisinopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and certain type of angina (chest pain) called as Prinzmetal or variant angina. It also protects the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

Before taking CALCHEK L 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension, angina and heart failure (such as cardiogenic shock or narrowing of heart valves).

Talk to your doctor if you are on a low salt diet or have diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea) before taking CALCHEK L 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

CALCHEK L 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure). It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects.

The most common side effects of taking CALCHEK L 5MG TABLET are dizziness, swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation and muscle cramps. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

introduction:
Introduction About ENAM 5MG TABLET

ENAM 5MG TABLET contains Enalapril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty breathing, swollen ankles and feet, or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity).

Before taking ENAM 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you are on a low-salt diet, have diabetes, or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

ENAM 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure) and in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking ENAM 5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with ENAM 5MG TABLET.

ENAM 5MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol, as it could aggravate your dizziness.

ENAM 5MG TABLET may reduce your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels during the therapy to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Other most common side effects of taking ENAM 5MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, tiredness, and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ENAM 5MG TABLET Works

ENAM 5MG TABLET effectively reduces blood pressure and signs of heart failure. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles, which reduces strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart failure.

Recommended Timing and Frequency of RAMCOR 5MG CAPSULE

RAMCOR 5MG CAPSULE is typically taken once daily, preferably at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in the bloodstream.

Some patients may be advised to take it in the morning, while others may benefit from an evening dose depending on their condition and treatment plan. It is important to follow your doctor’s instructions carefully and not alter the timing or frequency without consulting them.

Who Decides the Right Dosage for You?

The dosage of RAMCOR 5MG CAPSULE is determined by your healthcare provider based on your medical history, current health status, and response to therapy. It’s important to have an open discussion with your doctor before starting or adjusting your medication.

Should RAMCOR 5MG CAPSULE Be Taken With Food?

RAMCOR 5MG CAPSULE can generally be taken with or without food. Taking it with meals may help reduce occasional stomach discomfort. It’s best to maintain a consistent routine by taking the tablet at the same time each day to support steady blood levels of the medicine.

General Administration Instructions
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water.
Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to ensure proper absorption.
Follow the exact dosage and schedule prescribed by your healthcare provider.

Do not skip doses to maintain effectiveness.
Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking.

Adhering to the prescribed schedule helps in maintaining stable blood pressure and reduces strain on the heart. Any changes in dosage or frequency should be made only under medical supervision.

1. Role of ACE Inhibition in RAMISAVE 2.5MG CAPSULE

RAMISAVE 2.5MG CAPSULE contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. These medicines work by gently blocking the enzyme called Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme (ACE). This enzyme plays a part in narrowing blood vessels. By inhibiting ACE, RAMISAVE 2.5MG CAPSULE helps blood vessels stay relaxed and open, allowing blood to flow more freely. This supports the body’s natural process of maintaining balanced blood pressure levels.

2. How RAMISAVE 2.5MG CAPSULE affects blood flow and vessel function

By helping blood vessels relax, RAMISAVE 2.5MG CAPSULE improves blood flow throughout the body. This eases of blood flow reduces the effort the heart needs to pump blood, which supports overall cardiovascular health. When blood vessels work efficiently, organs and tissues receive the oxygen and nutrients they need to function well.

3. Ramipril and its interaction with the cardiovascular system

Ramipril influences the cardiovascular system by targeting the renin-angiotensin system, which regulates blood vessel constriction and fluid balance. By balancing this system, ramipril encourages healthier vessel function and supports the regulation of fluid levels in the body, which can influence blood pressure and heart workload.

4. How RAMISAVE 2.5MG CAPSULE supports natural blood pressure regulation

RAMISAVE 2.5MG CAPSULE assists the body’s natural mechanisms to regulate blood pressure without abrupt changes. This gradual support helps to maintain steady blood pressure, which is important for reducing stress on the heart and blood vessels over time. Using RAMISAVE 2.5MG CAPSULE as directed under medical supervision helps promote this balanced approach to cardiovascular health.

introduction:
Introduction About HOPACE H 5MG CAPSULE

HOPACE H 5MG CAPSULE is a combination of Ramipril and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors and Diuretics respectively. It is used in the management of essential hypertension.

Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke.

Before taking HOPACE H 5MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. Inform your doctor if you have any problems related to kidney, liver, lungs or heart and if you have other conditions such as diabetes, gout, myopia, glaucoma, collagen vascular disease or parathyroid disease.

HOPACE H 5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents less than 18 years of age. If you are taking any other medicines for other conditions or if you have history of allergy, inform to your doctor as it may manage drug-related interactions and serious side effect.

The most common side effect of HOPACE H 5MG CAPSULE are headache, dizziness, stomach pain, tiredness and nausea. Consult your doctor for advice if your symptoms get worsen over the time.

mechanismOfAction:
How HOPACE H 5MG CAPSULE Works

HOPACE H 5MG CAPSULE helps to reduce high blood pressure, where Ramipril works by inhibiting the activity of an enzyme called Angiotensin converting enzyme (an enzyme which is responsible for causing constriction of blood vessels) which enhances easy flow of blood around the body. Hydrochlorothiazide works by decreasing the extra fluid volume also works by managing reabsorption of sodium in the kidneys, which in turn it relaxes the blood vessels and makes the blood flow more easily in the passage of blood vessels and thus lowers the blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About LISTRIL 5MG TABLET

LISTRIL 5MG TABLET contains Lisinopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty in breathing, swollen ankles and feet or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity) and can reduce kidney damage in diabetic patients who have high blood pressure.

Before taking LISTRIL 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

LISTRIL 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking LISTRIL 5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with LISTRIL 5MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How LISTRIL 5MG TABLET Works

LISTRIL 5MG TABLET is an ACE inhibitor. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE), that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart and the kidneys. This reduces strain on the heart and kidneys, improves their functions and manages the risks of heart failure or kidney damage.
usageDetails:
How to use LISTRIL 5MG TABLET

Take LISTRIL 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. LISTRIL 5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking LISTRIL 5MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About HOPACE H 2.5MG CAPSULE

HOPACE H 2.5MG CAPSULE is a combination of Ramipril and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors and Diuretics respectively. It is used in the management of essential hypertension.

Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke.

Before taking HOPACE H 2.5MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. Inform your doctor if you have any problems related to kidney, liver, lungs or heart and if you have other conditions such as diabetes, gout, myopia, glaucoma, collagen vascular disease or parathyroid disease.

HOPACE H 2.5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents less than 18 years of age. If you are taking any other medicines for other conditions or if you have history of allergy, inform to your doctor as it may manage drug-related interactions and serious side effect.

The most common side effect of HOPACE H 2.5MG CAPSULE are headache, dizziness, stomach pain, tiredness and nausea. Consult your doctor for advice if your symptoms get worsen over the time.

mechanismOfAction:
How HOPACE H 2.5MG CAPSULE Works

HOPACE H 2.5MG CAPSULE helps to reduce high blood pressure, where Ramipril works by inhibiting the activity of an enzyme called Angiotensin converting enzyme (an enzyme which is responsible for causing constriction of blood vessels) which enhances easy flow of blood around the body. Hydrochlorothiazide works by decreasing the extra fluid volume also works by managing reabsorption of sodium in the kidneys, which in turn it relaxes the blood vessels and makes the blood flow more easily in the passage of blood vessels and thus lowers the blood pressure.

Personal or family history of angioedema
Electrolyte disturbances

Diabetes

Dehydration problems
Upcoming major surgery including dental surgery which requires anaesthesia for numbness or sedation

introduction:
Introduction About CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET

CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET is a combination of Ramipril and Atorvastatin which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor and HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor respectively. CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET is used to manage high blood pressure and high levels of cholesterol and triglycerides in the blood. CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET is also used to reduce the risk of heart attack or stroke.

Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries. Cholesterol and triglycerides are fats that are made in your body and found in some foods that can block the blood vessels which can increase the risk of heart attack and stroke, or other complications.

Heart attack is a condition which occurs due to blocked or reduced flow of blood to the heart muscle. Stroke is a condition which occurs due to blockage of blood supply to the brain or when the blood vessel in the brain ruptures and bleed.

Before taking CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems related to kidney, liver, lungs, and heart or if you have other conditions or problems such as diabetes, hypothyroidism, low blood pressure, dehydration problems, collagen vascular disease (such as scleroderma).

Before taking CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. Consult your doctor for advice.

If you are taking any other medicines for other conditions or if you have history of drug allergy inform to your doctor as it may manage drug-related interactions and serious side effect.

Your doctor may check your kidney function, blood pressure, electrolyte levels in your blood at regular intervals during management with CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, dizziness, diarrhoea, muscle, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if your side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET Works

CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure and high cholesterol and triglyceride levels in the blood, where Ramipril works by inhibiting the activity of an enzyme called Angiotensin converting enzyme (an enzyme which is responsible for causing constriction of blood vessels) which enhances easy flow of blood around the body. Atorvastatin works by inhibiting the action of an enzyme called HMG-CoA reductase, which is required by the liver for the formation of cholesterol.

Take CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and disease condition.

CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment and not recommended for use in patients with renal artery stenosis (narrowing of blood vessels that leads to kidney) or patients undergoing dialysis or other types of blood filtration methods. CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment and not recommended for use in patients with active liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET.
