CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe respiratory failure. Consult your doctor before taking CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET.
CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems. Consult with your doctor before taking CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET.

Others

CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

History of angioedema
Low or unstable blood pressure

Before taking CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Desensitization management for allergic reactions due to bee or wasp stings
High levels of potassium in the blood
Upcoming major surgery including dental surgery which requires anaesthesia for numbness or sedation
Condition or management that may cause decrease in sodium levels in the blood
Collagen vascular disease such as scleroderma or systemic lupus erythematosus
Previous history of stroke bleeding into the brain, or have small pockets of fluid accumulation due to stroke
Hypothyroidism
History of muscle problems  

Use in pediatrics:

CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET.

Use in geriatrics:

CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age, usually initiating the management with lowest effective. Consult your doctor taking CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET inform to your doctor if you are taking any of these following medicines:

Indomethacin, ibuprofen, aspirin (used to relieve pain and swelling)
Ephedrine, noradrenaline, or adrenaline (used to manage low blood pressure, asthma, allergies, or heart failure)
Sacubitril/valsartan (used to manage long-term heart failure)
Ciclosporin, sirolimus, everolimus (used to manage organ rejection after transplant)
Furosemide (used to manage edema or high blood pressure)
Potassium salts or potassium-sparing diuretics such as spironolactone, amiloride, triamterene (used to retain or increase potassium levels)
Erythromycin, clarithromycin, telithromycin, fusidic acid, trimethoprim alone or in combination with sulfamethoxazole (used to manage bacterial infections)
Warfarin, heparin (used to manage blood clots)
Prednisolone (used to manage swelling)
Allopurinol, colchicine (used to manage gout or decrease uric acid levels in blood)
Procainamide (used to manage irregular heart rate)
Temsirolimus (used to manage cancer)
Racecadotril (used to manage diarrhea)
Insulin, vildagliptin (used to manage diabetes)
Telmisartan, olmesartan or aliskiren (used to manage high blood pressure)
Lithium (used to manage mental health problems)
Ketoconazole, itraconazole, voriconazole, fluconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Gemfibrozil, ezetimibe, colestipol (used to manage high cholesterol levels)
Verapamil, amiodarone, and digoxin (used to manage irregular heart rhythm)
Amlodipine, diltiazem (used to manage high blood pressure or angina)
Letermovir (used to manage cytomegalovirus)
Ritonavir, lopinavir, atazanavir and combination of tipranavir/ritonavir (used to manage HIV)

Cimetidine (used to manage heartburn and peptic ulcers)
Phenazone (used to manage pain)
Antacids containing aluminium or magnesium (used to manage indigestion)

B. Drug-Food interactions:

While taking CARDACE PROTECT 2.5MG TABLET, avoid taking large quantities of grapefruit juice as it can alter the effects of this medicine resulting in undesired therapeutic outcome.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of this medicine, consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdosage are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, electrolyte disturbances, and kidney failure.

Introduction About MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET

MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of compounds known as Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors. This medication is generally prescribed under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner for cardiovascular health support and blood pressure management.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with the medicine.

MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding women, consult your doctor for advice before taking MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects of taking MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea or skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET Works
1. Role of ACE Inhibition in MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET

MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. These medicines work by gently blocking the enzyme called Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme (ACE). This enzyme plays a part in narrowing blood vessels. By inhibiting ACE, MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET helps blood vessels stay relaxed and open, allowing blood to flow more freely. This supports the body’s natural process of maintaining balanced blood pressure levels.

2. How MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET affects blood flow and vessel function

By helping blood vessels relax, MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET improves blood flow throughout the body. This eases of blood flow reduces the effort the heart needs to pump blood, which supports overall cardiovascular health. When blood vessels work efficiently, organs and tissues receive the oxygen and nutrients they need to function well.

3. Ramipril and its interaction with the cardiovascular system

Ramipril influences the cardiovascular system by targeting the renin-angiotensin system, which regulates blood vessel constriction and fluid balance. By balancing this system, ramipril encourages healthier vessel function and supports the regulation of fluid levels in the body, which can influence blood pressure and heart workload.

4. How MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET supports natural blood pressure regulation

MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET assists the body’s natural mechanisms to regulate blood pressure without abrupt changes. This gradual support helps to maintain steady blood pressure, which is important for reducing stress on the heart and blood vessels over time. Using MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET as directed under medical supervision helps promote this balanced approach to cardiovascular health.

Is Long-term use of MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET safe?

MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET(Ramipril) is often used for ongoing support under the supervision of a healthcare professional. Your doctor will periodically review your health and kidney function to ensure that the medicine continues to suit your needs.

When do MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET side effects usually subside?

Some mild side effects may appear when starting MACPRIL 2.5MG TABLET, such as dizziness or a dry cough. These effects often lessen as your body adjusts to the medicine, typically within a few weeks. introduction:
Introduction About DILVAS 2.5MG TABLET

DILVAS 2.5MG TABLET contains Enalapril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty breathing, swollen ankles and feet, or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity).

Before taking DILVAS 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you are on a low-salt diet, have diabetes, or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

DILVAS 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure) and in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking DILVAS 2.5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with DILVAS 2.5MG TABLET.

DILVAS 2.5MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol, as it could aggravate your dizziness.

DILVAS 2.5MG TABLET may reduce your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels during the therapy to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Other most common side effects of taking DILVAS 2.5MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, tiredness, and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DILVAS 2.5MG TABLET Works

DILVAS 2.5MG TABLET effectively reduces blood pressure and signs of heart failure. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles, which reduces strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart failure.

Take DILVAS 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. DILVAS 2.5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking DILVAS 2.5MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Before taking DILVAS 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines, such as:

Racecadotril (a medicine used to manage diarrhea)
Medicines that supplement potassium to the body (Ex. spironolactone, triamterene, or amiloride)
Trimethoprim containing antibiotics (used for infections)
Medicines used to manage organ transplant rejection (Ex. ciclosporin, temsirolimus, sirolimus, and everolimus)
Heparin (used to manage blood clots)
Medicines used for heart conditions such as hypertension, chest pain, irregular heartbeats, or heart failure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, furosemide, bumetanide, nitroglycerin, valsartan, aliskiren, procainamide, sacubitril/valsartan)
Lithium (a medicine used in some types of mental illness)
Tricyclic antidepressants (used to manage depression) Ex. amitriptyline
Antipsychotics (used to manage serious mental illnesses) Ex. clozapine, risperidone
Anesthetics (used to manage pain during surgery) Ex. propofol, thiopental
Medicines used to relieve pain (Ex. morphine, aspirin, ibuprofen, celecoxib)
Thrombolytics (used to dissolve blood clots) Ex. reteplase, tenecteplase
Gold therapy (to manage rheumatic conditions)
Medicines used to suppress cough (such as dextromethorphan, guaiphenesin, and pseudoephedrine)

Introduction About AMLOSAFE LS 5/5MG TABLET

AMLOSAFE LS 5/5MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Lisinopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and certain type of angina (chest pain) called as Prinzmetal or variant angina. It can also be used to manage heart failure and reduce the chances of hospitalization among the heart patients.

It also protects the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

Before taking AMLOSAFE LS 5/5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension, angina and heart failure (such as cardiogenic shock or narrowing of heart valves).

Talk to your doctor if you are on a low salt diet or have diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea) before taking AMLOSAFE LS 5/5MG TABLET as a precaution.

AMLOSAFE LS 5/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure). It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects.

The most common side effects of taking AMLOSAFE LS 5/5MG TABLET are dizziness, swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation and muscle cramps. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

Introduction About RAMICURE 5MG TABLET

RAMICURE 5MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the category of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. This tablet is often considered by healthcare professionals for maintaining heart and vascular health like hypertension and heart failure. It is a prescription-only medication and must be used under medical supervision.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Also might advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with RAMICURE 5MG TABLET.

RAMICURE 5MG TABLET is not advisable for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, inform your doctor for advice before taking RAMICURE 5MG TABLET. It is not considered for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMICURE 5MG TABLET Works

RAMICURE 5MG TABLET decreases blood pressure by reducing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). RAMICURE 5MG TABLET distributes well amongst your body tissues. Which in turn, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

How to use RAMICURE 5MG TABLET
Recommended Timing and Frequency of RAMICURE 5MG TABLET

RAMICURE 5MG TABLET is typically taken once daily, preferably at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in the bloodstream.

Some patients may be advised to take it in the morning, while others may benefit from an evening dose depending on their condition and treatment plan. It is important to follow your doctor’s instructions carefully and not alter the timing or frequency without consulting them.

Who Decides the Right Dosage for You?

The dosage of RAMICURE 5MG TABLET is determined by your healthcare provider based on your medical history, current health status, and response to therapy. It’s important to have an open discussion with your doctor before starting or adjusting your medication.

Should RAMICURE 5MG TABLET Be Taken With Food?

RAMICURE 5MG TABLET can generally be taken with or without food. Taking it with meals may help reduce occasional stomach discomfort. It’s best to maintain a consistent routine by taking the tablet at the same time each day to support steady blood levels of the medicine.

General Administration Instructions
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water.
Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to ensure proper absorption.
Follow the exact dosage and schedule prescribed by your healthcare provider.
Things to Remember While Using RAMICURE 5MG TABLET
Do not skip doses to maintain effectiveness.
Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking.
Regular check-ups may be advised to monitor your health and kidney function.
Avoid sudden changes in posture to prevent dizziness.
Importance of Following Your Doctor’s Schedule

Adhering to the prescribed schedule helps in maintaining stable blood pressure and reduces strain on the heart. Any changes in dosage or frequency should be made only under medical supervision.

After starting RAMICURE 5MG TABLET, some individuals may notice initial changes such as mild dizziness or tiredness. These effects are generally temporary and often improve within a few days to a couple of weeks as the body adjusts to the medication.

It’s important to continue taking the medicine as prescribed, even if you experience mild effects early on. If any effects persist beyond a few weeks or cause discomfort, you should consult your healthcare provider for guidance.

Remember, the full benefits of RAMICURE 5MG TABLET in supporting heart and blood vessel function may take several weeks of regular use to become apparent, so patience and adherence to your prescribed schedule are key.

What to Discuss With Your Doctor Before Using RAMICURE 5MG TABLET

Before starting RAMICURE 5MG TABLET, it’s important to have an open conversation with your healthcare provider to ensure safe and effective use. Consider discussing the following points:

Your Medical History: Inform your doctor about any history of kidney or liver problems, heart conditions, or allergies.
Current Medications: Share details of all prescription, over-the-counter medicines, supplements, and herbal products you are taking.
Pregnancy or Breastfeeding: If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, discuss the potential risks and alternatives.
Symptoms to Watch For: Understand which symptoms or side effects require immediate medical attention, such as swelling, severe dizziness, or difficulty breathing.
Lifestyle Factors: Talk about your diet, alcohol use, and any lifestyle habits that may affect your medication’s effectiveness.
Follow-up Plan: Clarify how often you should have check-ups or blood tests to monitor your progress and safety.
Medicines Often Prescribed Alongside ACE Inhibitors

RAMICURE 5MG TABLET belongs to the class of ACE inhibitors commonly used in managing cardiovascular health. Doctors may prescribe additional medicines to complement its effects, such as:

Diuretics (Water Pills): Help reduce excess fluid and support blood pressure control.
Beta-Blockers: Assist in managing heart rate and reducing heart strain.
Calcium Channel Blockers: Help relax blood vessels and improve blood flow.
Statins: Used to manage cholesterol levels as part of overall heart health.

introduction:
Introduction About HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET

HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET is a combination of Metoprolol and Ramipril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and angina (chest pain). It can also be used to manage heart failure and reduces the chances of hospitalization among the heart patients.

It also protects the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

Before taking HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from hypertension, angina and heart failure. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, COPD, diabetes, severe dehydration due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea), psoriasis or muscle problems before taking HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET as a precaution.

HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure). It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects.

The most common side effects of taking HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET are dizziness, swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, sleepiness, tiredness, indigestion, constipation and muscle cramps. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET Works

HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET contains two medicines namely metoprolol and ramipril. Metoprolol is a beta-blocker. It blocks the effects of certain chemicals in the body (such as adrenaline) that increases heart rate and blood pressure.

Ramipril is an ACE inhibitor. It blocks the effects of certain enzymes in the body (such as angiotensin converting enzyme (ACE)) that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

Collectively, blocking the actions of adrenaline and ACE reduces the strain on the heart and relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and the kidneys, which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to them and reduces blood pressure and kidney damage.

Take HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Continue to take HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Therefore, inform your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. If you accidentally become pregnant while undergoing therapy with HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor immediately.
HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure and make you feel dizzier or faint.

HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment (including dialysis or narrowing or renal arteries). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems (including kidney transplantation). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver failure. It should be used with caution in patients with other minor liver problems (such as liver cirrhosis). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Do not take HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET if you are allergic to Metoprolol, Ramipril or to any other beta-blockers (such as propranolol, atenolol) or ACE inhibitors (such as captopril, enalapril, lisinopril).
HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe lung problems (such as asthma, COPD or any form of breathing difficulties). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

HOPACE MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems (such as slow or irregular heartbeat, severe heart failure, recent heart attack). It should be used with caution in patients with other minor heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Are in shock
Have unmanageed phaeochromocytoma (a tumor of adrenal gland)
Have metabolic acidosis (increased acidity in blood)
Have problems in blood circulation (such as Raynaud’s disease)
Have block in blood vessels
Have a type of angina called Prinzmetal’s angina
Have severe low blood pressure
Suffer from frequent episodes of low blood sugar levels

Have dry eyes

Introduction About ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE

ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE contains Ramipril, which belongs to the category of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. This tablet is often considered by healthcare professionals for maintaining heart and vascular health like hypertension and heart failure. It is a prescription-only medication and must be used under medical supervision.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Also might advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE.

ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE is not advisable for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, inform your doctor for advice before taking ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE. It is not considered for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE Works

ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE decreases blood pressure by reducing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE distributes well amongst your body tissues. Which in turn, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

How to use ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE
Recommended Timing and Frequency of ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE

ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE is typically taken once daily, preferably at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in the bloodstream.

Some patients may be advised to take it in the morning, while others may benefit from an evening dose depending on their condition and treatment plan. It is important to follow your doctor’s instructions carefully and not alter the timing or frequency without consulting them.

Who Decides the Right Dosage for You?

The dosage of ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE is determined by your healthcare provider based on your medical history, current health status, and response to therapy. It’s important to have an open discussion with your doctor before starting or adjusting your medication.

Should ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE Be Taken With Food?

ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE can generally be taken with or without food. Taking it with meals may help reduce occasional stomach discomfort. It’s best to maintain a consistent routine by taking the tablet at the same time each day to support steady blood levels of the medicine.

General Administration Instructions
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water.
Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to ensure proper absorption.
Follow the exact dosage and schedule prescribed by your healthcare provider.
Things to Remember While Using ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE
Do not skip doses to maintain effectiveness.
Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking.
Regular check-ups may be advised to monitor your health and kidney function.
Avoid sudden changes in posture to prevent dizziness.
Importance of Following Your Doctor’s Schedule

Adhering to the prescribed schedule helps in maintaining stable blood pressure and reduces strain on the heart. Any changes in dosage or frequency should be made only under medical supervision.

After starting ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE, some individuals may notice initial changes such as mild dizziness or tiredness. These effects are generally temporary and often improve within a few days to a couple of weeks as the body adjusts to the medication.

It’s important to continue taking the medicine as prescribed, even if you experience mild effects early on. If any effects persist beyond a few weeks or cause discomfort, you should consult your healthcare provider for guidance.

Remember, the full benefits of ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE in supporting heart and blood vessel function may take several weeks of regular use to become apparent, so patience and adherence to your prescribed schedule are key.

More Information
What to Discuss With Your Doctor Before Using ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE

Before starting ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE, it’s important to have an open conversation with your healthcare provider to ensure safe and effective use. Consider discussing the following points:

Your Medical History: Inform your doctor about any history of kidney or liver problems, heart conditions, or allergies.
Current Medications: Share details of all prescription, over-the-counter medicines, supplements, and herbal products you are taking.
Pregnancy or Breastfeeding: If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, discuss the potential risks and alternatives.
Symptoms to Watch For: Understand which symptoms or side effects require immediate medical attention, such as swelling, severe dizziness, or difficulty breathing.
Lifestyle Factors: Talk about your diet, alcohol use, and any lifestyle habits that may affect your medication’s effectiveness.
Follow-up Plan: Clarify how often you should have check-ups or blood tests to monitor your progress and safety.
Medicines Often Prescribed Alongside ACE Inhibitors

ZOREM 5MG CAPSULE belongs to the class of ACE inhibitors commonly used in managing cardiovascular health. Doctors may prescribe additional medicines to complement its effects, such as:

Diuretics (Water Pills): Help reduce excess fluid and support blood pressure control.
Beta-Blockers: Assist in managing heart rate and reducing heart strain.
Calcium Channel Blockers: Help relax blood vessels and improve blood flow.
Statins: Used to manage cholesterol levels as part of overall heart health.

introduction:
Introduction About COVERSYL AM 8/5MG TABLET

COVERSYL AM 8/5MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Perindopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and a certain type of angina (chest pain) called Prinzmetal or variant angina. It can also be used to manage heart failure.

It is also useful in the management of coronary artery disease (low blood supply to the heart) and reduces the chances of hospitalization among heart patients.

Before taking COVERSYL AM 8/5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension, angina and heart failure (such as cardiogenic shock or narrowing of heart valves).

Talk to your doctor if you are on a low salt diet or have diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhoea) before taking COVERSYL AM 8/5MG TABLET as a precaution.

COVERSYL AM 8/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure). It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to the increased risk of side effects.

The most common side effects of taking COVERSYL AM 8/5MG TABLET are dizziness, swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, low blood sugar levels and muscle cramps. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How COVERSYL AM 8/5MG TABLET Works

COVERSYL AM 8/5MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs. This improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces strain on the heart. It also allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. As a result, it reduces blood pressure and improves heart functions.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Continue to take COVERSYL AM 8/5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About RAMI RACE 10 TABLET

RAMI RACE 10 TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension). Blood pressure is the force exerted by the circulating blood on the walls of blood vessels. Hypertension is a condition in which the blood pressure is too high.

RAMI RACE 10 TABLET reduces the risk of kidney problems and can be used as a management following a heart attack. RAMI RACE 10 TABLET is also used to manage heart failure (a condition when the heart is not able to pump enough blood). Symptoms include headache, breathlessness, excess sweating, sleep disturbance, tingling and dizziness.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with RAMI RACE 10 TABLET.

RAMI RACE 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking RAMI RACE 10 TABLET. RAMI RACE 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

Uses Of RAMI RACE 10 TABLET
Manage increased blood pressure, heart failure

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMI RACE 10 TABLET Works

RAMI RACE 10 TABLET decreases blood pressure by decreasing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). RAMI RACE 10 TABLET distributes extensively amongst your body tissues. As a result, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

Have diabetes
Have abnormally low blood pressure

Have lost a lot of body salts or fluid (vomiting, diarrhea)

Have hyperkalemia (raised levels of potassium in the blood)

Introduction About ENAPRIL 10MG TABLET

ENAPRIL 10MG TABLET contains Enalapril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty breathing, swollen ankles and feet, or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity).

Before taking ENAPRIL 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you are on a low-salt diet, have diabetes, or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

ENAPRIL 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure) and in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking ENAPRIL 10MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with ENAPRIL 10MG TABLET.

ENAPRIL 10MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol, as it could aggravate your dizziness.

ENAPRIL 10MG TABLET may reduce your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels during the therapy to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Other most common side effects of taking ENAPRIL 10MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, tiredness, and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ENAPRIL 10MG TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How ENAPRIL 10MG TABLET Works

ENAPRIL 10MG TABLET effectively reduces blood pressure and signs of heart failure. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles, which reduces strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart failure.
usageDetails:
How to use ENAPRIL 10MG TABLET

Take ENAPRIL 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. ENAPRIL 10MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking ENAPRIL 10MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Introduction About HOPACE 5MG TABLET

HOPACE 5MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the category of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. This tablet is often considered by healthcare professionals for maintaining heart and vascular health like hypertension and heart failure. It is a prescription-only medication and must be used under medical supervision.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Also might advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with HOPACE 5MG TABLET.

HOPACE 5MG TABLET is not advisable for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, inform your doctor for advice before taking HOPACE 5MG TABLET. It is not considered for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

How to use HOPACE 5MG TABLET
Recommended Timing and Frequency of HOPACE 5MG TABLET

HOPACE 5MG TABLET is typically taken once daily, preferably at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in the bloodstream.

Some patients may be advised to take it in the morning, while others may benefit from an evening dose depending on their condition and treatment plan. It is important to follow your doctor’s instructions carefully and not alter the timing or frequency without consulting them.

Who Decides the Right Dosage for You?

The dosage of HOPACE 5MG TABLET is determined by your healthcare provider based on your medical history, current health status, and response to therapy. It’s important to have an open discussion with your doctor before starting or adjusting your medication.

Should HOPACE 5MG TABLET Be Taken With Food?

HOPACE 5MG TABLET can generally be taken with or without food. Taking it with meals may help reduce occasional stomach discomfort. It’s best to maintain a consistent routine by taking the tablet at the same time each day to support steady blood levels of the medicine.

General Administration Instructions
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water.
Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to ensure proper absorption.
Follow the exact dosage and schedule prescribed by your healthcare provider.
Things to Remember While Using HOPACE 5MG TABLET
Do not skip doses to maintain effectiveness.
Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking.
Regular check-ups may be advised to monitor your health and kidney function.
Avoid sudden changes in posture to prevent dizziness.
Importance of Following Your Doctor’s Schedule

Adhering to the prescribed schedule helps in maintaining stable blood pressure and reduces strain on the heart. Any changes in dosage or frequency should be made only under medical supervision.

introduction:
Introduction About AMTAS E TABLET

AMTAS E TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Enalapril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and certain type of angina (chest pain) called as Prinzmetal or variant angina. It can also be used to manage heart failure and reduce the chances of hospitalization among the heart patients.

Before taking AMTAS E TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension, angina and heart failure (such as cardiogenic shock or narrowing of heart valves).

Talk to your doctor if you are on a low salt diet or have diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea) before taking AMTAS E TABLET as a precaution.

AMTAS E TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure). It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects.

The most common side effects of taking AMTAS E TABLET are dizziness, swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, low blood sugar levels and muscle cramps. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of AMTAS E TABLET

It is used to:

Manage hypertension
Manage angina (such as Prinzmetal Angina)
Prevent heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How AMTAS E TABLET Works

AMTAS E TABLET is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs. This improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces strain on the heart. It also allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. As a result, it reduces blood pressure and improves heart functions.
usageDetails:
How to use AMTAS E TABLET

Take AMTAS E TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. AMTAS E TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Continue to take AMTAS E TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Therefore, inform your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. If you accidentally become pregnant while undergoing therapy with AMTAS E TABLET, inform your doctor immediately.
AMTAS E TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking AMTAS E TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking AMTAS E TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure and make you feel dizzier or faint.

AMTAS E TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment (including dialysis). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems (including kidney transplantation). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
AMTAS E TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Do not take AMTAS E TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine, Enalapril or to any other calcium antagonists (such as nifedipine, diltiazem) or ACE inhibitors (such as captopril, lisinopril, ramipril).

AMTAS E TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

AMTAS E TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have diabetes with impaired kidney functions

Before taking AMTAS E TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have problems in the blood vessels supplying the brain
Are on a salt-restricted diet
Are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness such as vomiting or diarrhea
Have low WBC, RBC and platelet count in the blood
Have diabetes
Have any autoimmune disease that affects the skin or collagen (Ex. lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis or scleroderma)
Are scheduled for any upcoming surgery
Are scheduled for LDL apheresis (a procedure to remove cholesterol from the blood)
Have any desensitization management (used to reduce the effect of an allergy to bee or wasp stings)

Use in Paediatrics:

AMTAS E TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) unless prescribed by a physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before consumption.

Use in Geriatrics:

AMTAS E TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking AMTAS E TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Racecadotril (a medicine used to manage diarrhea)
Medicines that supplement potassium to the body (Ex. spironolactone, triamterene or amiloride)
Trimethoprim containing antibiotics (used for infections)
Medicines used to manage organ transplant rejection (Ex. ciclosporin, temsirolimus, sirolimus, everolimus)
Heparin (used to manage blood clots)
Medicines used for heart conditions such as hypertension, chest pain, irregular heartbeats or heart failure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, furosemide, bumetanide, nitroglycerin, valsartan, aliskiren, procainamide, sacubitril/valsartan)
Lithium (a medicine used in some types of mental illness)
Tricyclic antidepressants (used to manage depression) Ex. amitriptyline
Antipsychotics (used to manage serious mental illnesses) Ex. clozapine, risperidone
Anesthetics (used to manage pain during surgery) Ex. propofol, thiopental
Medicines used to relieve pain (Ex. morphine, aspirin, ibuprofen, celecoxib, valdecoxib)
Thrombolytics (used to dissolve blood clots) Ex. reteplase, tenecteplase
Gold therapy (used to manage rheumatic conditions)
Medicines used to suppress cough (such as dextromethorphan, guaiphenesin, pseudoephedrine)
Anti-diabetic medicines and insulin (used to lower the blood glucose level) Ex. vildagliptin, metformin
Allopurinol (a medicine used to manage gout)
Other medicines used to manage high blood pressure or angina (Ex. diltiazem, verapamil)
Ketoconazole, itraconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Ritonavir, indinavir, nelfinavir (used in management of HIV infections)
Rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Dantrolene (a medicine used to manage muscle spasms)
Medicines used to control elevated cholesterol levels (Ex. simvastatin)
St. John’s wort (an herbal medicine used to manage depression)

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking AMTAS E TABLET, as it could reduce your blood pressure to an abnormal level.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more AMTAS E TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include dizziness, fainting, light-headedness, weakness, shock, cool or clampy skin fast heartbeat, anxiety, cough and shortness of breath.

Introduction About CARDACE METO 5MG TABLET

CARDACE METO 5MG TABLET is a combination of Metoprolol and Ramipril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and angina (chest pain). It can also be used to manage heart failure and reduces the chances of hospitalization among the heart patients.

It also protects the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

Before taking CARDACE METO 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems apart from hypertension, angina and heart failure. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, COPD, diabetes, severe dehydration due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea), psoriasis or muscle problems before taking CARDACE METO 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

CARDACE METO 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure). It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How CARDACE METO 5MG TABLET Works

CARDACE METO 5MG TABLET contains two medicines namely metoprolol and ramipril. Metoprolol is a beta-blocker. It blocks the effects of certain chemicals in the body (such as adrenaline) that increases heart rate and blood pressure.

Ramipril is an ACE inhibitor. It blocks the effects of certain enzymes in the body (such as angiotensin converting enzyme (ACE)) that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

Collectively, blocking the actions of adrenaline and ACE reduces the strain on the heart and relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and the kidneys, which improves blood flow and oxygen supply to them and reduces blood pressure and kidney damage.

Continue to take CARDACE METO 5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About RAMISAVE 10MG CAPSULE

RAMISAVE 10MG CAPSULE contains Ramipril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension). Blood pressure is the force exerted by the circulating blood on the walls of blood vessels. Hypertension is a condition in which the blood pressure is too high.

RAMISAVE 10MG CAPSULE reduces the risk of kidney problems and can be used as a management following a heart attack. RAMISAVE 10MG CAPSULE is also used to manage heart failure (a condition when the heart is not able to pump enough blood). Symptoms include headache, breathlessness, excess sweating, sleep disturbance, tingling and dizziness.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with RAMISAVE 10MG CAPSULE.

RAMISAVE 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking RAMISAVE 10MG CAPSULE. RAMISAVE 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.
uses: Manage increased blood pressure, heart failure
Manage and reduces the risk of getting a heart attack or stroke and slow down the worsening of kidney problems

Uses Of RAMISAVE 10MG CAPSULE
Manage increased blood pressure, heart failure

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMISAVE 10MG CAPSULE Works

RAMISAVE 10MG CAPSULE decreases blood pressure by decreasing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). RAMISAVE 10MG CAPSULE distributes extensively amongst your body tissues. As a result, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

Take RAMISAVE 10MG CAPSULE as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: ENALET 5mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ENALET 5MG TABLET

ENALET 5MG TABLET contains Enalapril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty breathing, swollen ankles and feet, or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity).

Before taking ENALET 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you are on a low-salt diet, have diabetes, or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

ENALET 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure) and in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking ENALET 5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with ENALET 5MG TABLET.

ENALET 5MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol, as it could aggravate your dizziness.

ENALET 5MG TABLET may reduce your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels during the therapy to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Other most common side effects of taking ENALET 5MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, tiredness, and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ENALET 5MG TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How ENALET 5MG TABLET Works

ENALET 5MG TABLET effectively reduces blood pressure and signs of heart failure. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles, which reduces strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart failure.

How to use ENALET 5MG TABLET

Take ENALET 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. ENALET 5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking ENALET 5MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About COVERSYL AM 4/5MG TABLET

COVERSYL AM 4/5MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Perindopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and a certain type of angina (chest pain) called Prinzmetal or variant angina. It can also be used to manage heart failure.

It is also useful in the management of coronary artery disease (low blood supply to the heart) and reduces the chances of hospitalization among heart patients.

Before taking COVERSYL AM 4/5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension, angina and heart failure (such as cardiogenic shock or narrowing of heart valves).

Talk to your doctor if you are on a low salt diet or have diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhoea) before taking COVERSYL AM 4/5MG TABLET as a precaution.

COVERSYL AM 4/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure). It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to the increased risk of side effects.

The most common side effects of taking COVERSYL AM 4/5MG TABLET are dizziness, swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, low blood sugar levels and muscle cramps. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How COVERSYL AM 4/5MG TABLET Works

COVERSYL AM 4/5MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs. This improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces strain on the heart. It also allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. As a result, it reduces blood pressure and improves heart functions.
usageDetails:
How to use COVERSYL AM 4/5MG TABLET

Take COVERSYL AM 4/5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Continue to take COVERSYL AM 4/5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Introduction About ENAM 2.5MG TABLET

ENAM 2.5MG TABLET contains Enalapril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty breathing, swollen ankles and feet, or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity).

Before taking ENAM 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you are on a low-salt diet, have diabetes, or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

ENAM 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure) and in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking ENAM 2.5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with ENAM 2.5MG TABLET.

ENAM 2.5MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol, as it could aggravate your dizziness.

ENAM 2.5MG TABLET may reduce your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels during the therapy to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Other most common side effects of taking ENAM 2.5MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, tiredness, and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

How ENAM 2.5MG TABLET Works

ENAM 2.5MG TABLET effectively reduces blood pressure and signs of heart failure. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles, which reduces strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart failure.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking ENAM 2.5MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About RAMCOR 10MG CAPSULE

RAMCOR 10MG CAPSULE contains Ramipril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension). Blood pressure is the force exerted by the circulating blood on the walls of blood vessels. Hypertension is a condition in which the blood pressure is too high.

RAMCOR 10MG CAPSULE reduces the risk of kidney problems and can be used as a management following a heart attack. RAMCOR 10MG CAPSULE is also used to manage heart failure (a condition when the heart is not able to pump enough blood). Symptoms include headache, breathlessness, excess sweating, sleep disturbance, tingling and dizziness.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with RAMCOR 10MG CAPSULE.

RAMCOR 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking RAMCOR 10MG CAPSULE. RAMCOR 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

Uses Of RAMCOR 10MG CAPSULE
Manage increased blood pressure, heart failure

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMCOR 10MG CAPSULE Works

RAMCOR 10MG CAPSULE decreases blood pressure by decreasing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). RAMCOR 10MG CAPSULE distributes extensively amongst your body tissues. As a result, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

Take RAMCOR 10MG CAPSULE as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LISTRIL 2.5MG TABLET

LISTRIL 2.5MG TABLET contains Lisinopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty in breathing, swollen ankles and feet or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity) and can reduce kidney damage in diabetic patients who have high blood pressure.

Before taking LISTRIL 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

LISTRIL 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking LISTRIL 2.5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with LISTRIL 2.5MG TABLET.

LISTRIL 2.5MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate your dizziness.

Other most common side effects of taking LISTRIL 2.5MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, nausea and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How LISTRIL 2.5MG TABLET Works

LISTRIL 2.5MG TABLET is an ACE inhibitor. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE), that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart and the kidneys. This reduces strain on the heart and kidneys, improves their functions and manages the risks of heart failure or kidney damage.

Take LISTRIL 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. LISTRIL 2.5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking LISTRIL 2.5MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About MACPRIL 1.25MG TABLET

MACPRIL 1.25MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension). Blood pressure is the force exerted by the circulating blood on the walls of blood vessels. Hypertension is a condition in which the blood pressure is too high.

MACPRIL 1.25MG TABLET reduces the risk of kidney problems and can be used as a management following a heart attack. MACPRIL 1.25MG TABLET is also used to manage heart failure (a condition when the heart is not able to pump enough blood). Symptoms include headache, breathlessness, excess sweating, sleep disturbance, tingling and dizziness.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with MACPRIL 1.25MG TABLET.

MACPRIL 1.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking MACPRIL 1.25MG TABLET. MACPRIL 1.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.
uses: Manage increased blood pressure, heart failure
Manage and reduces the risk of getting a heart attack or stroke and slow down the worsening of kidney problems

Uses Of MACPRIL 1.25MG TABLET
Manage increased blood pressure, heart failure

mechanismOfAction:
How MACPRIL 1.25MG TABLET Works

MACPRIL 1.25MG TABLET decreases blood pressure by decreasing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). MACPRIL 1.25MG TABLET distributes extensively amongst your body tissues. As a result, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

Take MACPRIL 1.25MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PERIACE 2MG TABLET

PERIACE 2MG TABLET contains Perindopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension in adults. Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against blood vessel walls is too high. Symptoms of hypertension includes early morning headaches, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, feeling overtiredness, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, and chest pain. It is also used to manage heart failure (a condition where the pumping of heart is inadequate to meet body’s need which is characterized by shortness of breath, fatigue, fast heartbeat.). It also reduces the risk of cardiac events such as heart attack in patients with stable coronary artery disease (a condition where the blood supply to the heart is reduced or blocked resulting in pain or discomfort in chest, arms or shoulders; weakness, light-headedness and feeling sick), in patients who have the history of heart attack and/or an operation to improve blood supply to heart.

Perindopril works by inhibiting the activity of an enzyme called angiotensin converting enzyme (an enzyme which is responsible for causing constriction of blood vessels), resulting in easy flow of blood around the body. Your doctor may check your kidney function, blood pressure, and the amount of electrolytes (Ex. potassium) in your body prior to the management or at regular intervals along with the management.

PERIACE 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney artery stenosis.  PERIACE 2MG TABLET should be used in caution with patient having aortic stenosis, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, diabetes, liver, and kidney problems or under dialysis. If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. PERIACE 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years. The most common side effects of taking PERIACE 2MG TABLET are low blood pressure, headache, dizziness, muscle cramps, shortness of breath, cough and headache. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CARDIFINE 5 TABLET

CARDIFINE 5 TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the category of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. This tablet is often considered by healthcare professionals for maintaining heart and vascular health like hypertension and heart failure. It is a prescription-only medication and must be used under medical supervision.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Also might advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with CARDIFINE 5 TABLET.

CARDIFINE 5 TABLET is not advisable for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, inform your doctor for advice before taking CARDIFINE 5 TABLET. It is not considered for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How CARDIFINE 5 TABLET Works

CARDIFINE 5 TABLET decreases blood pressure by reducing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). CARDIFINE 5 TABLET distributes well amongst your body tissues. Which in turn, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

usageDetails:
How to use CARDIFINE 5 TABLET
Recommended Timing and Frequency of CARDIFINE 5 TABLET

CARDIFINE 5 TABLET is typically taken once daily, preferably at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in the bloodstream.

Some patients may be advised to take it in the morning, while others may benefit from an evening dose depending on their condition and treatment plan. It is important to follow your doctor’s instructions carefully and not alter the timing or frequency without consulting them.

Who Decides the Right Dosage for You?

The dosage of CARDIFINE 5 TABLET is determined by your healthcare provider based on your medical history, current health status, and response to therapy. It’s important to have an open discussion with your doctor before starting or adjusting your medication.

Should CARDIFINE 5 TABLET Be Taken With Food?

CARDIFINE 5 TABLET can generally be taken with or without food. Taking it with meals may help reduce occasional stomach discomfort. It’s best to maintain a consistent routine by taking the tablet at the same time each day to support steady blood levels of the medicine.

General Administration Instructions
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water.
Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to ensure proper absorption.
Follow the exact dosage and schedule prescribed by your healthcare provider.
Things to Remember While Using CARDIFINE 5 TABLET
Do not skip doses to maintain effectiveness.
Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking.
Regular check-ups may be advised to monitor your health and kidney function.
Avoid sudden changes in posture to prevent dizziness.
Importance of Following Your Doctor’s Schedule

Adhering to the prescribed schedule helps in maintaining stable blood pressure and reduces strain on the heart. Any changes in dosage or frequency should be made only under medical supervision.

After starting CARDIFINE 5 TABLET, some individuals may notice initial changes such as mild dizziness or tiredness. These effects are generally temporary and often improve within a few days to a couple of weeks as the body adjusts to the medication.

It’s important to continue taking the medicine as prescribed, even if you experience mild effects early on. If any effects persist beyond a few weeks or cause discomfort, you should consult your healthcare provider for guidance.

Remember, the full benefits of CARDIFINE 5 TABLET in supporting heart and blood vessel function may take several weeks of regular use to become apparent, so patience and adherence to your prescribed schedule are key.

More Information
What to Discuss With Your Doctor Before Using CARDIFINE 5 TABLET

Before starting CARDIFINE 5 TABLET, it’s important to have an open conversation with your healthcare provider to ensure safe and effective use. Consider discussing the following points:

Your Medical History: Inform your doctor about any history of kidney or liver problems, heart conditions, or allergies.
Current Medications: Share details of all prescription, over-the-counter medicines, supplements, and herbal products you are taking.
Pregnancy or Breastfeeding: If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, discuss the potential risks and alternatives.
Symptoms to Watch For: Understand which symptoms or side effects require immediate medical attention, such as swelling, severe dizziness, or difficulty breathing.
Lifestyle Factors: Talk about your diet, alcohol use, and any lifestyle habits that may affect your medication’s effectiveness.
Follow-up Plan: Clarify how often you should have check-ups or blood tests to monitor your progress and safety.
Medicines Often Prescribed Alongside ACE Inhibitors

CARDIFINE 5 TABLET belongs to the class of ACE inhibitors commonly used in managing cardiovascular health. Doctors may prescribe additional medicines to complement its effects, such as:

Diuretics (Water Pills): Help reduce excess fluid and support blood pressure control.
Beta-Blockers: Assist in managing heart rate and reducing heart strain.
Calcium Channel Blockers: Help relax blood vessels and improve blood flow.
Statins: Used to manage cholesterol levels as part of overall heart health.

Introduction About RAMISTAR H 5MG TABLET

RAMISTAR H 5MG TABLET is a combination of Ramipril and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors and Diuretics respectively. It is used in the management of essential hypertension.

Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke.

Before taking RAMISTAR H 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. Inform your doctor if you have any problems related to kidney, liver, lungs or heart and if you have other conditions such as diabetes, gout, myopia, glaucoma, collagen vascular disease or parathyroid disease.

RAMISTAR H 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents less than 18 years of age. If you are taking any other medicines for other conditions or if you have history of allergy, inform to your doctor as it may manage drug-related interactions and serious side effect.

The most common side effect of RAMISTAR H 5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, stomach pain, tiredness and nausea. Consult your doctor for advice if your symptoms get worsen over the time.
uses: Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)

Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How RAMISTAR H 5MG TABLET Works

RAMISTAR H 5MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where Ramipril works by inhibiting the activity of an enzyme called Angiotensin converting enzyme (an enzyme which is responsible for causing constriction of blood vessels) which enhances easy flow of blood around the body. Hydrochlorothiazide works by decreasing the extra fluid volume also works by managing reabsorption of sodium in the kidneys, which in turn it relaxes the blood vessels and makes the blood flow more easily in the passage of blood vessels and thus lowers the blood pressure.

Always take RAMISTAR H 5MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Take this medicine with or without food, swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RAMILET 1.25 TABLET

RAMILET 1.25 TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension). Blood pressure is the force exerted by the circulating blood on the walls of blood vessels. Hypertension is a condition in which the blood pressure is too high.

RAMILET 1.25 TABLET reduces the risk of kidney problems and can be used as a management following a heart attack. RAMILET 1.25 TABLET is also used to manage heart failure (a condition when the heart is not able to pump enough blood). Symptoms include headache, breathlessness, excess sweating, sleep disturbance, tingling and dizziness.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with RAMILET 1.25 TABLET.

RAMILET 1.25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking RAMILET 1.25 TABLET. RAMILET 1.25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.
uses: Manage increased blood pressure, heart failure
Manage and reduces the risk of getting a heart attack or stroke and slow down the worsening of kidney problems
usesDetails:
Uses Of RAMILET 1.25 TABLET
Manage increased blood pressure, heart failure
