mechanismOfAction:
How RAMILET 1.25 TABLET Works

RAMILET 1.25 TABLET decreases blood pressure by decreasing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). RAMILET 1.25 TABLET distributes extensively amongst your body tissues. As a result, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

How to use RAMILET 1.25 TABLET

Take RAMILET 1.25 TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET

COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Perindopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and a certain type of angina (chest pain) called Prinzmetal or variant angina. It can also be used to manage heart failure.

It is also useful in the management of coronary artery disease (low blood supply to the heart) and reduces the chances of hospitalization among heart patients.

Before taking COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension, angina and heart failure (such as cardiogenic shock or narrowing of heart valves).

Talk to your doctor if you are on a low salt diet or have diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhoea) before taking COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET as a precaution.

COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure). It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to the increased risk of side effects.

The most common side effects of taking COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET are dizziness, swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation, low blood sugar levels and muscle cramps. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET Works

COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs. This improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces strain on the heart. It also allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. As a result, it reduces blood pressure and improves heart functions.

Take COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Continue to take COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

If you accidentally become pregnant while undergoing therapy with COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET, inform your doctor immediately.
COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure and make you feel dizzier or faint.

COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment (including dialysis). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems (including kidney transplantation). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Do not take COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine, Perindopril or to any other calcium antagonists (such as nifedipine, diltiazem) or ACE inhibitors (such as captopril, lisinopril, ramipril)

COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart attack or heart failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have diabetes with impaired kidney functions

Before taking COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have problems in the blood vessels supplying the brain
Are on a salt-restricted diet
Are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness such as vomiting or diarrhoea
Have low WBC, RBC and platelet count in the blood
Have diabetes
Have any autoimmune disease that affects the skin or collagen (Ex. lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis, or scleroderma)
Are scheduled for any upcoming surgery
Have problems with the adrenal gland (such as adrenal insufficiency)
Are scheduled for LDL apheresis (a procedure to remove cholesterol from the blood)
Have any desensitization management (used to reduce the effect of an allergy to bee or wasp stings)

Use in paediatrics:

COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET is not generally recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). However, consult your doctor before consumption.

Use in geriatrics:

COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Racecadotril (a medicine used to manage diarrhea)
Medicines that supplement potassium to the body (Ex. spironolactone, triamterene or amiloride)
Trimethoprim containing antibiotics (used for infections)
Medicines used to manage organ transplant rejection (Ex. ciclosporin, temsirolimus, sirolimus, everolimus)
Heparin (used to manage blood clots)
Medicines used for heart conditions such as hypertension, chest pain, irregular heartbeats, or heart failure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, furosemide, bumetanide, nitroglycerin, valsartan, aliskiren, procainamide, sacubitril/valsartan)
Lithium (a medicine used in some types of mental illness)
Tricyclic antidepressants (used to manage depression) Ex. amitriptyline
Antipsychotics (used to manage serious mental illnesses) Ex. clozapine, risperidone
Anesthetics (used to manage pain during surgery) Ex. propofol, thiopental
Medicines used to relieve pain (Ex. morphine, aspirin, ibuprofen, celecoxib, valdecoxib)
Thrombolytics (used to dissolve blood clots) Ex. reteplase, tenecteplase
Gold therapy (used to manage rheumatic conditions)
Medicines used to suppress cough (such as dextromethorphan, guaiphenesin, pseudoephedrine)
Anti-diabetic medicines and insulin (used to lower the blood glucose level) Ex. vildagliptin, metformin
Allopurinol (a medicine used to manage gout)
Other medicines used to manage high blood pressure or angina (Ex. diltiazem, verapamil)
Ketoconazole, itraconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Ritonavir, indinavir, nelfinavir (used in management of HIV infections)
Rifampicin, erythromycin, clarithromycin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Dantrolene (a medicine used to manage muscle spasms)
Medicines used to control elevated cholesterol levels (Ex. simvastatin)
St. John’s wort (an herbal medicine used to manage depression)

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET, as it could reduce your blood pressure to an abnormal level.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more COVERSYL AM 8/10MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include dizziness, fainting, light-headedness, weakness, shock, cool or clampy skin fast heartbeat, anxiety, cough and shortness of breath.

introduction:
Introduction About RAMILET 5 TABLET

RAMILET 5 TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the category of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. This tablet is often considered by healthcare professionals for maintaining heart and vascular health like hypertension and heart failure. It is a prescription-only medication and must be used under medical supervision.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Also might advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with RAMILET 5 TABLET.

RAMILET 5 TABLET is not advisable for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, inform your doctor for advice before taking RAMILET 5 TABLET. It is not considered for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMILET 5 TABLET Works

RAMILET 5 TABLET decreases blood pressure by reducing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). RAMILET 5 TABLET distributes well amongst your body tissues. Which in turn, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

How to use RAMILET 5 TABLET
Recommended Timing and Frequency of RAMILET 5 TABLET

RAMILET 5 TABLET is typically taken once daily, preferably at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in the bloodstream.

Some patients may be advised to take it in the morning, while others may benefit from an evening dose depending on their condition and treatment plan. It is important to follow your doctor’s instructions carefully and not alter the timing or frequency without consulting them.

Who Decides the Right Dosage for You?

The dosage of RAMILET 5 TABLET is determined by your healthcare provider based on your medical history, current health status, and response to therapy. It’s important to have an open discussion with your doctor before starting or adjusting your medication.

Should RAMILET 5 TABLET Be Taken With Food?

RAMILET 5 TABLET can generally be taken with or without food. Taking it with meals may help reduce occasional stomach discomfort. It’s best to maintain a consistent routine by taking the tablet at the same time each day to support steady blood levels of the medicine.

General Administration Instructions
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water.
Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to ensure proper absorption.
Follow the exact dosage and schedule prescribed by your healthcare provider.
Things to Remember While Using RAMILET 5 TABLET
Do not skip doses to maintain effectiveness.
Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking.
Regular check-ups may be advised to monitor your health and kidney function.
Avoid sudden changes in posture to prevent dizziness.
Importance of Following Your Doctor’s Schedule

Adhering to the prescribed schedule helps in maintaining stable blood pressure and reduces strain on the heart. Any changes in dosage or frequency should be made only under medical supervision.

How Long Do Initial Effects Usually Last?

After starting RAMILET 5 TABLET, some individuals may notice initial changes such as mild dizziness or tiredness. These effects are generally temporary and often improve within a few days to a couple of weeks as the body adjusts to the medication.

It’s important to continue taking the medicine as prescribed, even if you experience mild effects early on. If any effects persist beyond a few weeks or cause discomfort, you should consult your healthcare provider for guidance.

Remember, the full benefits of RAMILET 5 TABLET in supporting heart and blood vessel function may take several weeks of regular use to become apparent, so patience and adherence to your prescribed schedule are key.

More Information
What to Discuss With Your Doctor Before Using RAMILET 5 TABLET

Before starting RAMILET 5 TABLET, it’s important to have an open conversation with your healthcare provider to ensure safe and effective use. Consider discussing the following points:

Your Medical History: Inform your doctor about any history of kidney or liver problems, heart conditions, or allergies.
Current Medications: Share details of all prescription, over-the-counter medicines, supplements, and herbal products you are taking.
Pregnancy or Breastfeeding: If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, discuss the potential risks and alternatives.
Symptoms to Watch For: Understand which symptoms or side effects require immediate medical attention, such as swelling, severe dizziness, or difficulty breathing.
Lifestyle Factors: Talk about your diet, alcohol use, and any lifestyle habits that may affect your medication’s effectiveness.
Follow-up Plan: Clarify how often you should have check-ups or blood tests to monitor your progress and safety.
Medicines Often Prescribed Alongside ACE Inhibitors

RAMILET 5 TABLET belongs to the class of ACE inhibitors commonly used in managing cardiovascular health. Doctors may prescribe additional medicines to complement its effects, such as:

Diuretics (Water Pills): Help reduce excess fluid and support blood pressure control.
Beta-Blockers: Assist in managing heart rate and reducing heart strain.
Calcium Channel Blockers: Help relax blood vessels and improve blood flow.
Statins: Used to manage cholesterol levels as part of overall heart health.
Tablets Used in Cardiac Management Plans

Beyond ACE inhibitors like RAMILET 5 TABLET, cardiac care often involves a variety of tablets tailored to support heart function and circulation, including:

Antiplatelet agents to reduce blood clot risks
Nitrates to ease chest discomfort
Blood thinners for certain heart conditions

introduction:
Introduction About COVERSYL 2MG TABLET

COVERSYL 2MG TABLET contains Perindopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension in adults. Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against blood vessel walls is too high. Symptoms of hypertension includes early morning headaches, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, feeling overtiredness, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, and chest pain. It is also used to manage heart failure (a condition where the pumping of heart is inadequate to meet body’s need which is characterized by shortness of breath, fatigue, fast heartbeat.). It also reduces the risk of cardiac events such as heart attack in patients with stable coronary artery disease (a condition where the blood supply to the heart is reduced or blocked resulting in pain or discomfort in chest, arms or shoulders; weakness, light-headedness and feeling sick), in patients who have the history of heart attack and/or an operation to improve blood supply to heart.

Perindopril works by inhibiting the activity of an enzyme called angiotensin converting enzyme (an enzyme which is responsible for causing constriction of blood vessels), resulting in easy flow of blood around the body. Your doctor may check your kidney function, blood pressure, and the amount of electrolytes (Ex. potassium) in your body prior to the management or at regular intervals along with the management.

COVERSYL 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney artery stenosis.  COVERSYL 2MG TABLET should be used in caution with patient having aortic stenosis, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, diabetes, liver, and kidney problems or under dialysis. If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. COVERSYL 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years. The most common side effects of taking COVERSYL 2MG TABLET are low blood pressure, headache, dizziness, muscle cramps, shortness of breath, cough and headache. Consult your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

Symptoms of acute renal failure like decreased urinary output, swelling due to fluid retention, nausea, fatigue, and shortness of breath.

Irregular heartbeat or fast heartbeat, chest pain or heart attack
Signs of stroke like difficulty in walking, speaking, and understanding
Sudden wheezing, tightness in chest, difficulty in breathing (bronchospasm)

Signs of hepatitis like jaundice (yellowing of skin and eyes)

name: Lipril H Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About LIPRIL H

LIPRIL H is a combination of Lisinopril and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used in the management of hypertension (high blood pressure). It is typically used in patients who have not responded adequately to therapy with either of the single agents.

Before taking LIPRIL H inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or severe dehydration as a precaution.

LIPRIL H is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension or severe kidney problems. It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to the increased risk of side effects.

During management with LIPRIL H your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking LIPRIL H are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LIPRIL H
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How LIPRIL H Works

LIPRIL H is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use LIPRIL H

Take LIPRIL H as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. LIPRIL H can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Continue to take LIPRIL H for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

warnings.details: LIPRIL H is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing fetus. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. If you accidentally become pregnant while undergoing therapy with LIPRIL H, inform your doctor immediately.
LIPRIL H is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking LIPRIL H.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking LIPRIL H as it may severely decrease your blood pressure and make you feel dizzier or faint.

LIPRIL H is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment (including dialysis). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems (including kidney transplantation or renal artery stenosis). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
LIPRIL H is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take LIPRIL H if you are allergic to Hydrochlorothiazide, Lisinopril or to any other ACE inhibitor (such as captopril, enalapril, ramipril).

LIPRIL H should be used with caution in patients with asthma. It should also be used with caution among patients who previously developed any breathing problems following the consumption of this medicine. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

LIPRIL H should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (such as ischemic heart disease (low oxygen supply to heart muscles), heart block, narrowing of heart valves, heart failure etc.). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

LIPRIL H is not recommended for you, if you:

Have a family history of allergic reactions (such as angioedema)
Are not passing urine
Have diabetes with impaired kidney functions
Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)

Before taking LIPRIL H, inform your doctor if you:

Have any blood disorders
Have low blood pressure
Are on a salt-restricted diet
Are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness such as vomiting or diarrhea
Have problems in the blood vessels supplying the brain
Have any autoimmune disease that affects the skin or collagen (Ex. lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis, or scleroderma)
Have gout (joint pain caused due to accumulation of uric acid)
Have diabetes
Have hyperkalaemia (high blood potassium levels)
Have fluids/electrolyte imbalance in the body
Are going to check your parathyroid gland
Have previously had skin cancer
Are scheduled for any upcoming surgery
Are scheduled for LDL apheresis (a procedure to remove cholesterol from the blood)
Have any desensitization management (used to reduce the effect of an allergy to bee or wasp stings)

Use in paediatrics:

LIPRIL H is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before consumption.

Use in geriatrics:

LIPRIL H should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

name: TELVILITE CH 40 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TELVILITE CH 40 TABLET

TELVILITE CH 40 TABLET is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) in affected individuals when monotherapy with chlorthalidone or telmisartan becomes inadequate to control the condition. It is also used as initial therapy in patients who are indicated for multiple drug therapy to control high blood pressure. It is a combination of Chlorthalidone and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics and Angiotensin II receptor blockers, respectively.

TELVILITE CH 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to chlorthalidone, telmisartan, and/or any sulphonamide-derived medicines. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from anuria and severe liver impairment. Before taking the medicine, inform your doctor if you have liver problems, kidney problems and/or heart problems (such as congestive heart failure).

TELVILITE CH 40 TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women since it passes through breast milk. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 to 18 years) and in elders (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects are back pain, sore throat, nausea, abdominal pain, indigestion, diarrhoea, and/or headache. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TELVILITE CH 40 TABLET
Used to manage hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How TELVILITE CH 40 TABLET Works

TELVILITE CH 40 TABLET helps to lower blood pressure, where telmisartan works by blocking angiotensin (a hormone responsible for regulating blood pressure and maintaining fluid balance in the body) which leads to relaxation of blood vessels and Chlorthalidone works by removing extra water and certain electrolytes from the body which leads to relaxation of blood pressure and improved blood flow thus reducing high blood pressure in affected individuals.

Introduction About REBEAT 5MG TABLET

REBEAT 5MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the category of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. This tablet is often considered by healthcare professionals for maintaining heart and vascular health like hypertension and heart failure. It is a prescription-only medication and must be used under medical supervision.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Also might advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with REBEAT 5MG TABLET.

REBEAT 5MG TABLET is not advisable for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, inform your doctor for advice before taking REBEAT 5MG TABLET. It is not considered for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How REBEAT 5MG TABLET Works

REBEAT 5MG TABLET decreases blood pressure by reducing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). REBEAT 5MG TABLET distributes well amongst your body tissues. Which in turn, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

How to use REBEAT 5MG TABLET
Recommended Timing and Frequency of REBEAT 5MG TABLET

REBEAT 5MG TABLET is typically taken once daily, preferably at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in the bloodstream.

Some patients may be advised to take it in the morning, while others may benefit from an evening dose depending on their condition and treatment plan. It is important to follow your doctor’s instructions carefully and not alter the timing or frequency without consulting them.

Who Decides the Right Dosage for You?

The dosage of REBEAT 5MG TABLET is determined by your healthcare provider based on your medical history, current health status, and response to therapy. It’s important to have an open discussion with your doctor before starting or adjusting your medication.

Should REBEAT 5MG TABLET Be Taken With Food?

REBEAT 5MG TABLET can generally be taken with or without food. Taking it with meals may help reduce occasional stomach discomfort. It’s best to maintain a consistent routine by taking the tablet at the same time each day to support steady blood levels of the medicine.

General Administration Instructions
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water.
Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to ensure proper absorption.
Follow the exact dosage and schedule prescribed by your healthcare provider.
Things to Remember While Using REBEAT 5MG TABLET
Do not skip doses to maintain effectiveness.
Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking.
Regular check-ups may be advised to monitor your health and kidney function.
Avoid sudden changes in posture to prevent dizziness.
Importance of Following Your Doctor’s Schedule

Adhering to the prescribed schedule helps in maintaining stable blood pressure and reduces strain on the heart. Any changes in dosage or frequency should be made only under medical supervision.

After starting REBEAT 5MG TABLET, some individuals may notice initial changes such as mild dizziness or tiredness. These effects are generally temporary and often improve within a few days to a couple of weeks as the body adjusts to the medication.

It’s important to continue taking the medicine as prescribed, even if you experience mild effects early on. If any effects persist beyond a few weeks or cause discomfort, you should consult your healthcare provider for guidance.

Remember, the full benefits of REBEAT 5MG TABLET in supporting heart and blood vessel function may take several weeks of regular use to become apparent, so patience and adherence to your prescribed schedule are key.

More Information
What to Discuss With Your Doctor Before Using REBEAT 5MG TABLET

Before starting REBEAT 5MG TABLET, it’s important to have an open conversation with your healthcare provider to ensure safe and effective use. Consider discussing the following points:

Your Medical History: Inform your doctor about any history of kidney or liver problems, heart conditions, or allergies.
Current Medications: Share details of all prescription, over-the-counter medicines, supplements, and herbal products you are taking.
Pregnancy or Breastfeeding: If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, discuss the potential risks and alternatives.
Symptoms to Watch For: Understand which symptoms or side effects require immediate medical attention, such as swelling, severe dizziness, or difficulty breathing.
Lifestyle Factors: Talk about your diet, alcohol use, and any lifestyle habits that may affect your medication’s effectiveness.
Follow-up Plan: Clarify how often you should have check-ups or blood tests to monitor your progress and safety.
Medicines Often Prescribed Alongside ACE Inhibitors

REBEAT 5MG TABLET belongs to the class of ACE inhibitors commonly used in managing cardiovascular health. Doctors may prescribe additional medicines to complement its effects, such as:

Diuretics (Water Pills): Help reduce excess fluid and support blood pressure control.
Beta-Blockers: Assist in managing heart rate and reducing heart strain.
Calcium Channel Blockers: Help relax blood vessels and improve blood flow.
Statins: Used to manage cholesterol levels as part of overall heart health.

Beyond ACE inhibitors like REBEAT 5MG TABLET, cardiac care often involves a variety of tablets tailored to support heart function and circulation, including:

introduction:
Introduction About DILVAS 10MG TABLET

DILVAS 10MG TABLET contains Enalapril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) Inhibitors. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty breathing, swollen ankles and feet, or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity).

Before taking DILVAS 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you are on a low-salt diet, have diabetes, or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

DILVAS 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure) and in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking DILVAS 10MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with DILVAS 10MG TABLET.

DILVAS 10MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol, as it could aggravate your dizziness.

DILVAS 10MG TABLET may reduce your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels. Therefore, your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar levels and electrolyte levels during the therapy to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Other most common side effects of taking DILVAS 10MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, tiredness, and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:

Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
Manage heart failure
mechanismOfAction:
How DILVAS 10MG TABLET Works

DILVAS 10MG TABLET effectively reduces blood pressure and signs of heart failure. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles, which reduces strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart failure.

Take DILVAS 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. DILVAS 10MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not stop taking DILVAS 10MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About RAMISTAR AM 2.5MG TABLET

RAMISTAR AM 2.5MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Ramipril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and certain type of angina (chest pain) called as Prinzmetal or variant angina. It can also be used to manage heart failure and reduce the chances of hospitalization among the heart patients.

It also protects the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

Before taking RAMISTAR AM 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension, angina and heart failure (such as cardiogenic shock or narrowing of heart valves).

Talk to your doctor if you are on a low salt diet or have diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea) before taking RAMISTAR AM 2.5MG TABLET as a precaution.

RAMISTAR AM 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure). It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects.

The most common side effects of taking RAMISTAR AM 2.5MG TABLET are dizziness, swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation and muscle cramps. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMISTAR AM 2.5MG TABLET Works

RAMISTAR AM 2.5MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs (such as kidneys). This improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces strain on the heart.

It also allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It can improve blood supply to the kidneys which helps in delaying the worsening of kidney functions in diabetic patients. As a result, it reduces blood pressure and improves the functions of the heart and the kidneys.

Take RAMISTAR AM 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. RAMISTAR AM 2.5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Continue to take RAMISTAR AM 2.5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

RAMISTAR AM 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Do not take RAMISTAR AM 2.5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine, Ramipril or to any other calcium antagonists (such as nifedipine, diltiazem) or ACE inhibitors (such as captopril, lisinopril, enalapril).

Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)
Have diabetes with impaired kidney functions

Before taking RAMISTAR AM 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Racecadotril (a medicine used to manage diarrhea)

Medicines used to manage organ transplant rejection (Ex. ciclosporin, temsirolimus, sirolimus, everolimus)
Heparin (used to manage blood clots)
Medicines used for heart conditions such as hypertension, chest pain, irregular heartbeats or heart failure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, furosemide, bumetanide, nitroglycerin, valsartan, aliskiren, procainamide, sacubitril/valsartan)
Lithium (a medicine used in some types of mental illness)
Medicines used to relieve pain (Ex. morphine, aspirin, ibuprofen, celecoxib, valdecoxib)
Anti-diabetic medicines and insulin (used to lower the blood glucose level) Ex. vildagliptin, metformin
Corticosteroids (used to relieve pain and inflammation) Ex. prednisone
Allopurinol (a medicine used to manage gout)
Other medicines used to manage high blood pressure or angina (Ex. diltiazem, verapamil)
Ketoconazole, itraconazole (used to manage fungal infections)

Introduction About RAMICON 5 TABLET

RAMICON 5 TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the category of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. This tablet is often considered by healthcare professionals for maintaining heart and vascular health like hypertension and heart failure. It is a prescription-only medication and must be used under medical supervision.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Also might advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with RAMICON 5 TABLET.

RAMICON 5 TABLET is not advisable for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, inform your doctor for advice before taking RAMICON 5 TABLET. It is not considered for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

How RAMICON 5 TABLET Works

RAMICON 5 TABLET decreases blood pressure by reducing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). RAMICON 5 TABLET distributes well amongst your body tissues. Which in turn, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

How to use RAMICON 5 TABLET
Recommended Timing and Frequency of RAMICON 5 TABLET

RAMICON 5 TABLET is typically taken once daily, preferably at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in the bloodstream.

Some patients may be advised to take it in the morning, while others may benefit from an evening dose depending on their condition and treatment plan. It is important to follow your doctor’s instructions carefully and not alter the timing or frequency without consulting them.

Who Decides the Right Dosage for You?

The dosage of RAMICON 5 TABLET is determined by your healthcare provider based on your medical history, current health status, and response to therapy. It’s important to have an open discussion with your doctor before starting or adjusting your medication.

Should RAMICON 5 TABLET Be Taken With Food?

RAMICON 5 TABLET can generally be taken with or without food. Taking it with meals may help reduce occasional stomach discomfort. It’s best to maintain a consistent routine by taking the tablet at the same time each day to support steady blood levels of the medicine.

General Administration Instructions
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water.
Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to ensure proper absorption.
Follow the exact dosage and schedule prescribed by your healthcare provider.
Things to Remember While Using RAMICON 5 TABLET
Do not skip doses to maintain effectiveness.
Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking.
Regular check-ups may be advised to monitor your health and kidney function.
Avoid sudden changes in posture to prevent dizziness.
Importance of Following Your Doctor’s Schedule

Adhering to the prescribed schedule helps in maintaining stable blood pressure and reduces strain on the heart. Any changes in dosage or frequency should be made only under medical supervision.

What to Discuss With Your Doctor Before Using RAMICON 5 TABLET

Before starting RAMICON 5 TABLET, it’s important to have an open conversation with your healthcare provider to ensure safe and effective use. Consider discussing the following points:

Current Medications: Share details of all prescription, over-the-counter medicines, supplements, and herbal products you are taking.
Pregnancy or Breastfeeding: If you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, discuss the potential risks and alternatives.

RAMICON 5 TABLET belongs to the class of ACE inhibitors commonly used in managing cardiovascular health. Doctors may prescribe additional medicines to complement its effects, such as:

Introduction About LIPRIL 2.5MG TABLET

LIPRIL 2.5MG TABLET contains Lisinopril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and heart failure. It also manages the onset of signs of symptoms of heart failure (such as difficulty in breathing, swollen ankles and feet or extreme tiredness even after a mild physical activity) and can reduce kidney damage in diabetic patients who have high blood pressure.

Before taking LIPRIL 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems (other than hypertension and heart failure). You must also inform your doctor if you have severe hypotension (low blood pressure), diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea).

LIPRIL 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects. Stop taking LIPRIL 2.5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with LIPRIL 2.5MG TABLET.

LIPRIL 2.5MG TABLET may cause dizziness while standing up suddenly or while changing positions, especially during the initial days of the therapy. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines as a precaution. Also, avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate your dizziness.

Other most common side effects of taking LIPRIL 2.5MG TABLET are dizziness, headache, nausea and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How LIPRIL 2.5MG TABLET Works

LIPRIL 2.5MG TABLET is an ACE inhibitor. It works by blocking the actions of an enzyme called angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE), that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure. As a result, it relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure.

It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart and the kidneys. This reduces strain on the heart and kidneys, improves their functions and manages the risks of heart failure or kidney damage.

Take LIPRIL 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. LIPRIL 2.5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking LIPRIL 2.5MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

LIPRIL 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems apart from hypertension and heart failure (such as irregular heartbeat, heart valve disease or enlarged heart). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About TELVILITE 40 AMH TABLET

TELVILITE 40 AMH TABLET is a combination medication specifically designed to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when a single therapy is insufficient. By effectively lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of severe complications such as heart attack, stroke, and kidney damage.

This medicine combines the benefits of Telmisartan, Amlodipine, and Hydrochlorothiazide, providing a comprehensive solution to manage high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, improving blood flow, and increasing urine output (diuretic effect) to help reduce fluid retention, which can contribute to high blood pressure.

Take TELVILITE 40 AMH TABLET with or without food, ideally at the same time every day for maximum effectiveness. As it contains a diuretic (water pill), it may cause increased urination. Avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent sleep disturbances.

Even if you feel well, continue using this medication as prescribed, as hypertension often shows no symptoms but poses significant health risks if untreated.

Before taking TELVILITE 40 AMH TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding before starting this medication. Let your doctor know about any other medications you’re taking, especially those for heart conditions or blood pressure.

Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolytes, and blood sugar levels is essential to ensure the medicine is working effectively. By consistently taking TELVILITE 40 AMH TABLET and following medical advice, you can manage high blood pressure effectively and reduce the risk of life-threatening complications.

The most common side effects of TELVILITE 40 AMH TABLET includes headache, dizziness, and fatigue, taste changes, diarrhea, and sinusitis, flu-like symptoms and muscle weakness. Stay hydrated to manage side effects like dry mouth, muscle cramps, and excessive thirst. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor promptly.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELVILITE 40 AMH TABLET Works

TELVILITE 40 AMH TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema).

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood.

Reduce Processed Foods: Minimize foods high in preservatives, trans fats, and artificial sweeteners.
Increase Potassium-Rich Foods: Foods like bananas, spinach, and sweet potatoes help balance potassium levels.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water to prevent dehydration, which can exacerbate dizziness.
Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate activity most days of the week.
Manage Stress: Practice relaxation techniques such as deep breathing, yoga, or meditation.
Avoid Smoking and Excessive Alcohol: Both can interfere with the effectiveness of blood pressure medication.
Monitor Blood Pressure Regularly: Keep track of your readings and share them with your doctor.
Get Enough Sleep: Aim for 7-8 hours of quality sleep to support overall health.

These tips can complement your treatment and help manage hypertension effectively. Always consult your doctor for personalized advice.

introduction:
Introduction About RAMIPRES 1.25MG TABLET

RAMIPRES 1.25MG TABLET contains Ramipril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension). Blood pressure is the force exerted by the circulating blood on the walls of blood vessels. Hypertension is a condition in which the blood pressure is too high.

RAMIPRES 1.25MG TABLET reduces the risk of kidney problems and can be used as a management following a heart attack. RAMIPRES 1.25MG TABLET is also used to manage heart failure (a condition when the heart is not able to pump enough blood). Symptoms include headache, breathlessness, excess sweating, sleep disturbance, tingling and dizziness.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with RAMIPRES 1.25MG TABLET.

RAMIPRES 1.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking RAMIPRES 1.25MG TABLET. RAMIPRES 1.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMIPRES 1.25MG TABLET Works

RAMIPRES 1.25MG TABLET decreases blood pressure by decreasing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). RAMIPRES 1.25MG TABLET distributes extensively amongst your body tissues. As a result, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

Introduction About RAMCOR H 5MG TABLET

RAMCOR H 5MG TABLET is a combination of Ramipril and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors and Diuretics respectively. It is used in the management of essential hypertension.

Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke.

Before taking RAMCOR H 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. Inform your doctor if you have any problems related to kidney, liver, lungs or heart and if you have other conditions such as diabetes, gout, myopia, glaucoma, collagen vascular disease or parathyroid disease.

RAMCOR H 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents less than 18 years of age. If you are taking any other medicines for other conditions or if you have history of allergy, inform to your doctor as it may manage drug-related interactions and serious side effect.

The most common side effect of RAMCOR H 5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, stomach pain, tiredness and nausea. Consult your doctor for advice if your symptoms get worsen over the time.

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMCOR H 5MG TABLET Works

RAMCOR H 5MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where Ramipril works by inhibiting the activity of an enzyme called Angiotensin converting enzyme (an enzyme which is responsible for causing constriction of blood vessels) which enhances easy flow of blood around the body. Hydrochlorothiazide works by decreasing the extra fluid volume also works by managing reabsorption of sodium in the kidneys, which in turn it relaxes the blood vessels and makes the blood flow more easily in the passage of blood vessels and thus lowers the blood pressure.

Introduction About ENVAS H 5MG TABLET

ENVAS H 5MG TABLET is a combination of Enalapril and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used in the management of hypertension (high blood pressure). It is typically used in patients who have not responded adequately to therapy with either of the single agents.

Before taking ENVAS H 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or severe dehydration as a precaution.

ENVAS H 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension or severe kidney problems. It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects.

During management with ENVAS H 5MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking ENVAS H 5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, tiredness, low blood pressure, muscle cramps, low blood sugar levels and increased blood cholesterol and potassium levels. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ENVAS H 5MG TABLET
Manage hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How ENVAS H 5MG TABLET Works

ENVAS H 5MG TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use ENVAS H 5MG TABLET

Take ENVAS H 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. ENVAS H 5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Continue to take ENVAS H 5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

If you accidentally become pregnant while undergoing therapy with ENVAS H 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor immediately.
ENVAS H 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking ENVAS H 5MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ENVAS H 5MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure and make you feel dizzier or faint.

ENVAS H 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment (including dialysis). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems (including kidney transplantation or renal artery stenosis). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ENVAS H 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ENVAS H 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Hydrochlorothiazide, Enalapril or to any other ACE inhibitor (such as captopril lisinopril, ramipril).

ENVAS H 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma. It should also be used with caution among patients who previously developed any breathing problems following the consumption of this medicine. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ENVAS H 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (such as ischemic heart disease (low oxygen supply to heart muscles), heart block, narrowing of heart valves, heart failure etc.). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ENVAS H 5MG TABLET is not recommended for you, if you:

Have a family history of allergic reactions (such as angioedema)
Are not passing urine
Have diabetes with impaired kidney functions
Have severe low blood pressure (hypotension)

Before taking ENVAS H 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have any blood disorders
Have low blood pressure
Are on a salt-restricted diet
Are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness such as vomiting or diarrhea
Have problems in the blood vessels supplying the brain
Have any autoimmune disease that affects the skin or collagen (Ex. lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis or scleroderma)
Have gout (joint pain caused due to accumulation of uric acid)
Have diabetes
Have hyperkalaemia (high blood potassium levels)
Have fluids/electrolyte imbalance in the body
Are going to check your parathyroid gland
Have previously had skin cancer
Are scheduled for any upcoming surgery
Are scheduled for LDL apheresis (a procedure to remove cholesterol from the blood)
Have any desensitization management (used to reduce the effect of an allergy to bee or wasp stings)

Use in Paediatrics:

ENVAS H 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before consumption.

Use in Geriatrics:

ENVAS H 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Thrombolytics (used to dissolve blood clots) Ex. reteplase, tenecteplase
Other diuretics (used to reduce edema) Ex. furosemide, bumetanide

If you or anyone else accidentally took more ENVAS H 5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include low blood pressure, fast or slow heartbeat, palpitations, shock, fast breathing, cough, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, feeling sleepy and confused or anxious, excessive urination or not being able to urinate.

Introduction About RAMCOR 1.25MG CAPSULE

RAMCOR 1.25MG CAPSULE contains Ramipril, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used in the management of high blood pressure (hypertension). Blood pressure is the force exerted by the circulating blood on the walls of blood vessels. Hypertension is a condition in which the blood pressure is too high.

RAMCOR 1.25MG CAPSULE reduces the risk of kidney problems and can be used as a management following a heart attack. RAMCOR 1.25MG CAPSULE is also used to manage heart failure (a condition when the heart is not able to pump enough blood). Symptoms include headache, breathlessness, excess sweating, sleep disturbance, tingling and dizziness.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with RAMCOR 1.25MG CAPSULE.

RAMCOR 1.25MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, consult your doctor for advice before taking RAMCOR 1.25MG CAPSULE. RAMCOR 1.25MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMCOR 1.25MG CAPSULE Works

RAMCOR 1.25MG CAPSULE decreases blood pressure by decreasing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). RAMCOR 1.25MG CAPSULE distributes extensively amongst your body tissues. As a result, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

Introduction About RAMIHART H 5MG TABLET

RAMIHART H 5MG TABLET is a combination of Ramipril and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors and Diuretics respectively. It is used in the management of essential hypertension.

Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke.

Before taking RAMIHART H 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. Inform your doctor if you have any problems related to kidney, liver, lungs or heart and if you have other conditions such as diabetes, gout, myopia, glaucoma, collagen vascular disease or parathyroid disease.

RAMIHART H 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents less than 18 years of age. If you are taking any other medicines for other conditions or if you have history of allergy, inform to your doctor as it may manage drug-related interactions and serious side effect.

The most common side effect of RAMIHART H 5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, stomach pain, tiredness and nausea. Consult your doctor for advice if your symptoms get worsen over the time.

Uses Of RAMIHART H 5MG TABLET
Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How RAMIHART H 5MG TABLET Works

RAMIHART H 5MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where Ramipril works by inhibiting the activity of an enzyme called Angiotensin converting enzyme (an enzyme which is responsible for causing constriction of blood vessels) which enhances easy flow of blood around the body. Hydrochlorothiazide works by decreasing the extra fluid volume also works by managing reabsorption of sodium in the kidneys, which in turn it relaxes the blood vessels and makes the blood flow more easily in the passage of blood vessels and thus lowers the blood pressure.

Always take RAMIHART H 5MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Take this medicine with or without food, swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About RAMISTAR AM 5MG TABLET

RAMISTAR AM 5MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Ramipril which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) and certain type of angina (chest pain) called as Prinzmetal or variant angina. It can also be used to manage heart failure and reduce the chances of hospitalization among the heart patients.

It also protects the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

Before taking RAMISTAR AM 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other heart problems apart from hypertension, angina and heart failure (such as cardiogenic shock or narrowing of heart valves).

Talk to your doctor if you are on a low salt diet or have diabetes or are severely dehydrated due to any recent sickness (such as vomiting or diarrhea) before taking RAMISTAR AM 5MG TABLET as a precaution.

RAMISTAR AM 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure). It is also not suitable for use in women who are pregnant or breastfeeding due to increased risk of side effects.

The most common side effects of taking RAMISTAR AM 5MG TABLET are dizziness, swelling of ankles or other body parts, headache, sleepiness, tiredness, racing heartbeat, indigestion, constipation and muscle cramps. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMISTAR AM 5MG TABLET Works

RAMISTAR AM 5MG TABLET is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs (such as kidneys). This improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles which reduces strain on the heart.

It also allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It can improve blood supply to the kidneys which helps in delaying the worsening of kidney functions in diabetic patients. As a result, it reduces blood pressure and improves the functions of the heart and the kidneys.

Take RAMISTAR AM 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. RAMISTAR AM 5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Continue to take RAMISTAR AM 5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About RAMISTAR H 2.5MG TABLET

RAMISTAR H 2.5MG TABLET is a combination of Ramipril and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors and Diuretics respectively. It is used in the management of essential hypertension.

Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke.

Before taking RAMISTAR H 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. Inform your doctor if you have any problems related to kidney, liver, lungs or heart and if you have other conditions such as diabetes, gout, myopia, glaucoma, collagen vascular disease or parathyroid disease.

RAMISTAR H 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents less than 18 years of age. If you are taking any other medicines for other conditions or if you have history of allergy, inform to your doctor as it may manage drug-related interactions and serious side effect.

The most common side effect of RAMISTAR H 2.5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, stomach pain, tiredness and nausea. Consult your doctor for advice if your symptoms get worsen over the time.
uses: Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:
Uses Of RAMISTAR H 2.5MG TABLET
Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How RAMISTAR H 2.5MG TABLET Works

RAMISTAR H 2.5MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where Ramipril works by inhibiting the activity of an enzyme called Angiotensin converting enzyme (an enzyme which is responsible for causing constriction of blood vessels) which enhances easy flow of blood around the body. Hydrochlorothiazide works by decreasing the extra fluid volume also works by managing reabsorption of sodium in the kidneys, which in turn it relaxes the blood vessels and makes the blood flow more easily in the passage of blood vessels and thus lowers the blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use RAMISTAR H 2.5MG TABLET

Always take RAMISTAR H 2.5MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Take this medicine with or without food, swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About RAMISAVE 5MG CAPSULE

RAMISAVE 5MG CAPSULE contains Ramipril, which belongs to the category of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. This tablet is often considered by healthcare professionals for maintaining heart and vascular health like hypertension and heart failure. It is a prescription-only medication and must be used under medical supervision.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Also might advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with RAMISAVE 5MG CAPSULE.

RAMISAVE 5MG CAPSULE is not advisable for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, inform your doctor for advice before taking RAMISAVE 5MG CAPSULE. It is not considered for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

How to use RAMISAVE 5MG CAPSULE
Recommended Timing and Frequency of RAMISAVE 5MG CAPSULE

RAMISAVE 5MG CAPSULE is typically taken once daily, preferably at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in the bloodstream.

Some patients may be advised to take it in the morning, while others may benefit from an evening dose depending on their condition and treatment plan. It is important to follow your doctor’s instructions carefully and not alter the timing or frequency without consulting them.

Who Decides the Right Dosage for You?

The dosage of RAMISAVE 5MG CAPSULE is determined by your healthcare provider based on your medical history, current health status, and response to therapy. It’s important to have an open discussion with your doctor before starting or adjusting your medication.

Should RAMISAVE 5MG CAPSULE Be Taken With Food?

RAMISAVE 5MG CAPSULE can generally be taken with or without food. Taking it with meals may help reduce occasional stomach discomfort. It’s best to maintain a consistent routine by taking the tablet at the same time each day to support steady blood levels of the medicine.

General Administration Instructions
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water.
Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to ensure proper absorption.
Follow the exact dosage and schedule prescribed by your healthcare provider.
Things to Remember While Using RAMISAVE 5MG CAPSULE
Do not skip doses to maintain effectiveness.
Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking.
Regular check-ups may be advised to monitor your health and kidney function.
Avoid sudden changes in posture to prevent dizziness.
Importance of Following Your Doctor’s Schedule

Adhering to the prescribed schedule helps in maintaining stable blood pressure and reduces strain on the heart. Any changes in dosage or frequency should be made only under medical supervision.

What to Discuss With Your Doctor Before Using RAMISAVE 5MG CAPSULE

Before starting RAMISAVE 5MG CAPSULE, it’s important to have an open conversation with your healthcare provider to ensure safe and effective use. Consider discussing the following points:

Introduction About RAMIHART 2.5MG CAPSULE

RAMIHART 2.5MG CAPSULE contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of compounds known as Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors. This medication is generally prescribed under the supervision of a registered medical practitioner for cardiovascular health support and blood pressure management.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Your doctor may also advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with the medicine.

RAMIHART 2.5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding women, consult your doctor for advice before taking RAMIHART 2.5MG CAPSULE. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects of taking RAMIHART 2.5MG CAPSULE are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea or skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMIHART 2.5MG CAPSULE Works
1. Role of ACE Inhibition in RAMIHART 2.5MG CAPSULE

RAMIHART 2.5MG CAPSULE contains Ramipril, which belongs to a class of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. These medicines work by gently blocking the enzyme called Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme (ACE). This enzyme plays a part in narrowing blood vessels. By inhibiting ACE, RAMIHART 2.5MG CAPSULE helps blood vessels stay relaxed and open, allowing blood to flow more freely. This supports the body’s natural process of maintaining balanced blood pressure levels.

2. How RAMIHART 2.5MG CAPSULE affects blood flow and vessel function

By helping blood vessels relax, RAMIHART 2.5MG CAPSULE improves blood flow throughout the body. This eases of blood flow reduces the effort the heart needs to pump blood, which supports overall cardiovascular health. When blood vessels work efficiently, organs and tissues receive the oxygen and nutrients they need to function well.

3. Ramipril and its interaction with the cardiovascular system

Ramipril influences the cardiovascular system by targeting the renin-angiotensin system, which regulates blood vessel constriction and fluid balance. By balancing this system, ramipril encourages healthier vessel function and supports the regulation of fluid levels in the body, which can influence blood pressure and heart workload.

4. How RAMIHART 2.5MG CAPSULE supports natural blood pressure regulation

RAMIHART 2.5MG CAPSULE assists the body’s natural mechanisms to regulate blood pressure without abrupt changes. This gradual support helps to maintain steady blood pressure, which is important for reducing stress on the heart and blood vessels over time. Using RAMIHART 2.5MG CAPSULE as directed under medical supervision helps promote this balanced approach to cardiovascular health.

RAMIHART H 2.5MG TABLET is a combination of Ramipril and Hydrochlorothiazide which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors and Diuretics respectively. It is used in the management of essential hypertension.

Hypertension is a condition in which force of the blood is consistently high against the walls of the arteries which can increase the risk of heart disease, kidney disease and stroke.

Before taking RAMIHART H 2.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. Inform your doctor if you have any problems related to kidney, liver, lungs or heart and if you have other conditions such as diabetes, gout, myopia, glaucoma, collagen vascular disease or parathyroid disease.

The most common side effect of RAMIHART H 2.5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, stomach pain, tiredness and nausea. Consult your doctor for advice if your symptoms get worsen over the time.

introduction:
Introduction About RAMIHART 5MG CAPSULE

RAMIHART 5MG CAPSULE contains Ramipril, which belongs to the category of medicines known as ACE inhibitors. This tablet is often considered by healthcare professionals for maintaining heart and vascular health like hypertension and heart failure. It is a prescription-only medication and must be used under medical supervision.

Your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes such as eating healthy, adequate sleep, weight and stress management, quitting smoking and alcohol. Also might advise you to take relevant tests before and during the management with RAMIHART 5MG CAPSULE.

RAMIHART 5MG CAPSULE is not advisable for use in patients having kidney problems where blood supply to the kidney is reduced (renal artery stenosis), patients undergoing dialysis or having collagen vascular diseases (scleroderma and systemic lupus erythematosus).

If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, inform your doctor for advice before taking RAMIHART 5MG CAPSULE. It is not considered for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, hypotension (reduced blood pressure), inflammation of the sinuses (sinusitis), diarrhea, skin rash.

mechanismOfAction:
How RAMIHART 5MG CAPSULE Works

RAMIHART 5MG CAPSULE decreases blood pressure by reducing the production of substances that raises the blood pressure (Angiotensin Converting Enzyme). This in turn reduces constriction of veins (vasoconstriction). RAMIHART 5MG CAPSULE distributes well amongst your body tissues. Which in turn, it widens and relaxes your blood vessels, leading to efficient blood circulation.

usageDetails:
How to use RAMIHART 5MG CAPSULE
Recommended Timing and Frequency of RAMIHART 5MG CAPSULE

RAMIHART 5MG CAPSULE is typically taken once daily, preferably at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in the bloodstream.

Some patients may be advised to take it in the morning, while others may benefit from an evening dose depending on their condition and treatment plan. It is important to follow your doctor’s instructions carefully and not alter the timing or frequency without consulting them.

Who Decides the Right Dosage for You?

The dosage of RAMIHART 5MG CAPSULE is determined by your healthcare provider based on your medical history, current health status, and response to therapy. It’s important to have an open discussion with your doctor before starting or adjusting your medication.

Should RAMIHART 5MG CAPSULE Be Taken With Food?

RAMIHART 5MG CAPSULE can generally be taken with or without food. Taking it with meals may help reduce occasional stomach discomfort. It’s best to maintain a consistent routine by taking the tablet at the same time each day to support steady blood levels of the medicine.

General Administration Instructions
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water.
Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet to ensure proper absorption.
Follow the exact dosage and schedule prescribed by your healthcare provider.
Things to Remember While Using RAMIHART 5MG CAPSULE
Do not skip doses to maintain effectiveness.
Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking.
Regular check-ups may be advised to monitor your health and kidney function.
Avoid sudden changes in posture to prevent dizziness.
Importance of Following Your Doctor’s Schedule

Adhering to the prescribed schedule helps in maintaining stable blood pressure and reduces strain on the heart. Any changes in dosage or frequency should be made only under medical supervision.

After starting RAMIHART 5MG CAPSULE, some individuals may notice initial changes such as mild dizziness or tiredness. These effects are generally temporary and often improve within a few days to a couple of weeks as the body adjusts to the medication.
